## EP-20-S3: Karigar can see their own jobs

- **Story ID:** EP-20-S3
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Karigar can see their own jobs
- **As a:** Karigar
- **I want:** the Jobs tab to list my open jobs with title, pieces, purity, style, due label and reference image, and a job sheet with "What it should look like", "Finished piece must weigh", "Gold inside it, after stones", "Allowed to be off by" and "Note from the desk"
- **So that:** I know what is on my bench and what each piece must weigh without calling the desk (FR-20-2, FR-20-10, BR-20-1, BR-20-4)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given Vijay Kumar · KG-04 has MO-2026-118 "Peacock Ruby Pendant" (2 pieces · 22K · Antique, due today) and "Temple Haram" (1 piece · Chettinad, due in 9 days), when he opens `k-jobs`, then both cards show, MO-2026-118 first with "Due today", and the Temple Haram card shows "Target 84.5000 g · gold 78.4000 g".
  2. Given Vijay opens MO-2026-118, when the sheet loads, then it shows "Finished piece must weigh 18.2000 g", "Gold inside it, after stones 15.1000 g", "Allowed to be off by ± 500 mg", the reference image with "See bigger", the job status chip and the note from the desk.
  3. Given the job list, when the payload and the screen are checked, then no price, customer, lead, stock or other karigar's field appears (epic acceptance criterion 6).
  4. Given Vijay has no open jobs, when the tab loads, then it shows "Nothing on your bench. New work from the desk shows up here." and the "Finished jobs" line, for example "14 delivered this year".
  5. Given the jobs read fails or is slow, when the tab is open, then it shows the EP-08-S3 loading state and then the EP-08-S4 error with "Try again", and on a mobile connection a list of 20 jobs loads in under 2 seconds.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** List My jobs and Read My job use the EP-20-S1 filter and allow-list. Open jobs are those not handed over and not cancelled, sorted by agreed date (`confirmedDate` else `dueDate`), earliest first. Due labels ("Due today", "Due in 9 days", late) are computed from the agreed date in Asia/Kolkata (EP-10-S10). The "Finished jobs" count is jobs handed over in the current calendar year in Asia/Kolkata. Reference images are served through signed links for the karigar's own jobs only (EP-09-S9).
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** Consumed: "Karigar job status changed" (own jobs only) to refresh the list and sheet (EP-08-S9). New jobs arriving live are EP-20-S11.
- **Audit entry written:** No. Reading jobs changes nothing.
- **Data changes:** None in the product database. Moves the Jobs tab and `JobSheet` in `KarigarPhone.tsx` off `useStore()` and `jobsForKarigar` / `openJobsForKarigar` onto the EP-08 data layer. The Me tab shows the EP-16-S12 profile.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/09-karigar-phone.svg`, route `k-jobs` ("1 · WHAT IS ON MY BENCH", "My jobs", "Due today", "What it should look like", "See bigger", "Finished piece must weigh", "Gold inside it, after stones", "Allowed to be off by", "Note from the desk", "Finished jobs", tabs "Jobs", "Gold", "Me"). The mockup shows weights to 3 decimals; v1 shows 4.
- **Non-functional checks:** Precision: weights shown to 4 decimals from integer units of 0.0001 g; the tolerance shown in mg from the same units. Performance: jobs tab under 2 seconds on a mobile connection; images are the EP-09-S4 resized copies. Time: due labels in Asia/Kolkata. Availability: loading, error, offline and reconnecting states (EP-08-S3, EP-08-S4, EP-08-S10, EP-08-S11). Open question: whether the karigar should still see the date the desk asked for after confirming his own.
- **Depends on:** EP-20-S1, EP-20-S2, EP-19-S5, EP-09-S4, EP-09-S9, EP-10-S10, EP-16-S12, EP-08-S2, EP-08-S3, EP-08-S4, EP-08-S9, EP-08-S10, EP-08-S11, EP-08-S17
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-20-S4: Karigar can accept a job and confirm a date

- **Story ID:** EP-20-S4
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Karigar can accept a job and confirm a date
- **As a:** Karigar
- **I want:** on a job in `sent`, a "Will you make this?" box with "I will deliver by" and "Accept this job", which accepts the job and makes my date the agreed date
- **So that:** the desk knows I have the gold and the date I will deliver by (FR-20-3, BR-20-4)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given MO-2026-119 in `sent` with due date 17 Nov 2026, when Lakshmi Devi · KG-01 opens it, then "I will deliver by" is filled with 17 Nov 2026 and the line "The desk asked for 17 Nov." shows under "Accept this job".
  2. Given Lakshmi picks 16 Nov 2026 and presses "Accept this job", when the server commits, then the job is `accepted` with `confirmedDate` 16 Nov 2026, the "Gold received" step shows ticked, and the desk tracker moves the card to Accepted within about a second.
  3. Given Lakshmi clears the date and presses "Accept this job", when the phone checks it, then it shows "Pick the date you will deliver by." and sends nothing.
  4. Given a date before today in Asia/Kolkata, or a job already accepted, when the request reaches the server, then it refuses, the second case with "This job has already been accepted.", and the phone shows the sentence (EP-08-S5).
  5. Given MO-2026-119 is stopped, when Lakshmi opens it, then "Accept this job" is not offered and the notice "This job is stopped. Only the owner can start it again." shows.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Accept is the EP-19-S6 transition `sent` → `accepted`, callable only by the karigar linked to the job (EP-20-S1). The confirmed date is required and must be today or later in Asia/Kolkata (EP-10-S10). A stopped or cancelled job cannot be accepted. Version check on the job (EP-02-S14). Audit in the same transaction.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** Emitted after commit: "Karigar job status changed" (accepted, through EP-19-S7).
- **Audit entry written:** Yes, through EP-19-S6: actor, time, entity (job id), action (`job_accepted`), before (`sent`), after (`accepted`, confirmed date).
- **Data changes:** Updates `karigar_jobs.status`, `confirmedDate` and `version`. No new tables.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/09-karigar-phone.svg`, route `k-jobs` (step "Gold received"). The "Will you make this?" box is in the prototype `JobSheet` and not drawn on the mockup.
- **Non-functional checks:** Time: the date picker and the server check use Asia/Kolkata dates. Concurrency: a double tap or a retry after a drop applies once (EP-08-S6, EP-03-S8). Open question: whether the confirmed date may be later than the desk's due date, and whether the karigar keeps seeing the desk's date after confirming.
- **Depends on:** EP-20-S3, EP-19-S6, EP-19-S7, EP-03-S8, EP-08-S5, EP-08-S6, EP-10-S10
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-20-S5: Karigar can mark a job worked on and ready

- **Story ID:** EP-20-S5
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Karigar can mark a job worked on and ready
- **As a:** Karigar
- **I want:** under "Where is it now?", to tap "Working on it" and later "Ready for checking", one step at a time, with an optional note in "Anything to tell the desk?"
- **So that:** the desk sees how far each job has got without phoning me (FR-20-4, FR-20-7, BR-20-4, BR-20-5)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given MO-2026-119 is `accepted`, when Lakshmi Devi taps "Working on it", then the job is `on_bench`, the step is ticked, and only "Ready for checking" is enabled next.
  2. Given the job is `on_bench` and Lakshmi types "Clasp fitted, polishing tomorrow" in "Anything to tell the desk?", when she taps "Ready for checking", then the job is `ready` and `benchNote` holds the note.
  3. Given the job is `accepted`, when a request to mark it ready reaches the server, then it refuses with "Mark it as being worked on first." and the phone shows the sentence.

A stopped job cannot move (`stoppedGuard`). The bench note is trimmed and limited to 1,000 characters (proposed limit, to confirm). Version check on the job.

Consumed: "Problem raised on a job or piece" and "Problem cleared" (proposed, gap G26) to show and lift the stop on the sheet; until EP-24 emits them, the stop flag arrives on "Karigar job status changed".

- **Non-functional checks:** Concurrency: version check; a state that is no longer valid is refused with the reason (epic section 13). Availability: while the phone is disconnected the step buttons are disabled with the EP-08-S11 state and nothing is queued (D6 decided: online only).
- **Depends on:** EP-20-S3, EP-20-S4, EP-19-S6, EP-19-S7, EP-08-S5, EP-08-S11

## EP-20-S6: Karigar can hand over a ready job and create the parcel

- **Story ID:** EP-20-S6
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Karigar can hand over a ready job and create the parcel
- **As a:** Karigar
- **I want:** on a `ready` job, to tap "Sent to the showroom", which marks the job handed over and creates the arriving parcel in the same transaction
- **So that:** the staff see the parcel arrive and can weigh it at once (FR-20-5, BR-20-6)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given MO-2026-119 is `ready` and has no parcel, when Lakshmi Devi taps "Sent to the showroom", then the job is `handed_over`, a parcel BATCH-2026-NNN exists with karigar KG-01, job MO-2026-119, `stage` 1, `status` `open`, `verdict` `incomplete`, no weighings, and the phone shows "Sent. The desk will weigh it when it arrives."
  2. Given Rajesh Verma has `parcels` open, when the hand-over commits, then the new parcel appears in the list within about a second without a reload (epic acceptance criterion 2).
  3. Given MO-2026-119 is `on_bench` with no parcel, when a hand-over request reaches the server, then it refuses with "Mark the job ready before handing it over." and no parcel is created.
  4. Given the job is stopped, when a hand-over request reaches the server, then it refuses with "This job is stopped. Only the owner can start it again." and no parcel is created.
  5. Given the hand-over is sent twice with one idempotency key after a network drop, when the server processes it, then one parcel exists and the second call returns the same parcel id.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Create Hand-over is callable only by the karigar linked to the job (EP-20-S1). Allowed only from `ready`, or from `on_bench` after a send-back (EP-20-S7). The parcel id is the next `BATCH-YYYY-NNN` without duplicates. `arrivedAt` and the actor come from the server clock and session (EP-03-S3). Job update, parcel insert and audit commit or roll back together (EP-03-S6). Deduplicated by idempotency key (EP-03-S8). Version check on the job.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** Emitted after commit: "Karigar job status changed" (handed over, through EP-19-S7) and "Parcel handed over by karigar" to the Parcels-in screen (Owner and Staff).
- **Audit entry written:** Yes: actor, time, entity (job id and parcel id), action (`job_handed_over`, `parcel_created`), before (`ready`), after (`handed_over`, parcel id).
- **Data changes:** Inserts one row into `parcels` (EP-02-S6) and sets `karigar_jobs.parcelId`, `status` and `version`. Adds Create Hand-over to the shared contract and ports `handOver` from `src/store/transitions.ts` as a server service function.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/09-karigar-phone.svg`, route `k-jobs` ("Sent to the showroom"); the parcel appears on route `parcels` (built in EP-21). The rule is drawn on `docs/ux/mockups/12-state-lifecycles.svg` ("Handing over creates the arriving parcel.").
- **Non-functional checks:** Concurrency: version check and idempotency key stop a double parcel; a hand-over sent after the owner stopped the job is refused with the stopped sentence (criterion 4). Audit: the parcel creation is audited (EP-06-S7). Open question G14: one hand-over carrying several jobs is EP-20-S13; this story creates one parcel per job.
- **Depends on:** EP-20-S5, EP-19-S6, EP-19-S7, EP-02-S6, EP-02-S14, EP-03-S3, EP-03-S6, EP-03-S7, EP-03-S8, EP-06-S2, EP-06-S7, EP-07-S1, EP-07-S11
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-20-S7: Karigar can hand over again after a send-back

- **Story ID:** EP-20-S7
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Karigar can hand over again after a send-back
- **As a:** Karigar
- **I want:** when the owner has sent my parcel back and the job is on my bench again, to tap "Sent to the showroom" and have the same parcel reset to weighing, with its weighings, QC ticks and draft tags cleared
- **So that:** the corrected work comes back under the same parcel number and the staff weigh and tag it from the start (FR-20-6, BR-20-6)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given parcel BATCH-2026-044 has `resolution` `sent_back` and its job MO-2026-118 is `on_bench` with `parcelId` BATCH-2026-044, when Vijay Kumar taps "Sent to the showroom", then the job is `handed_over` and BATCH-2026-044 has `stage` 1, `status` `open`, `resolution` empty, `verdict` `incomplete`, `gapNetG` empty, `stoppedAt` empty, no weighings and no QC ticks.
  2. Given BATCH-2026-044 had 8 draft pieces tagged before the send-back, when the hand-over commits, then those 8 draft pieces no longer exist and no new parcel was created.
  3. Given the job is `on_bench` and its parcel is not sent back, when a hand-over request reaches the server, then it refuses with "Mark the job ready before handing it over."
  4. Given the parcel holds a piece that is not in draft, when the hand-over runs, then the server refuses and nothing changes, because only draft tags may be cleared.
  5. Given Rajesh Verma has `parcels` open, when the reset commits, then BATCH-2026-044 shows again as arrived at the weigh stage without a reload.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Same caller rule as EP-20-S6. The reset path applies only when the job's parcel has `resolution` `sent_back`. Weighings, QC ticks and the parcel's draft pieces are deleted and the parcel reset in one transaction with the job update and the audit entry. Version checks on the job and the parcel.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** Emitted after commit: "Karigar job status changed" (handed over) and "Parcel handed over by karigar" (same parcel id).
- **Audit entry written:** Yes: actor, time, entity (job id and parcel id), action (`job_handed_over`, `parcel_reset_after_send_back`), before (parcel stage, verdict, weighing count, draft tag numbers), after (stage 1, `incomplete`).
- **Data changes:** Updates `parcels`; deletes its weighing and QC tick child rows and its draft rows in `pieces`; updates `karigar_jobs`. No new tables.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/09-karigar-phone.svg`, route `k-jobs` ("Sent to the showroom"). The send-back itself is on `docs/ux/mockups/22-owner-clear-mismatch.svg` (EP-23). No screen shows the reset to the karigar.
- **Non-functional checks:** Concurrency: version check on the parcel so a reset cannot race a staff member still tagging it. Audit: the cleared tag numbers are kept in the audit entry. Open question: whether tag numbers of cleared draft pieces may be reused (EP-15-S6 and EP-15-S7). Until EP-23 exists, the sent-back state is seeded for tests.
- **Depends on:** EP-20-S6, EP-02-S5, EP-02-S6, EP-02-S14, EP-03-S6, EP-06-S2, EP-06-S3, EP-06-S7, EP-15-S7
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-20-S8: Karigar can raise a problem on a job

- **Story ID:** EP-20-S8
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Karigar can raise a problem on a job
- **As a:** Karigar
- **I want:** a "Raise a problem" button on my open job that asks "What is wrong" and stops the job until the owner starts it again
- **So that:** I can stop work when something is wrong, such as loose stones or short gold, and the owner hears about it (FR-20-9, BR-20-5)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given MO-2026-118 is `on_bench` and not stopped, when Vijay Kumar presses "Raise a problem", types "Two kemp stones are loose." and sends, then a problem with target kind `job`, `raisedByRole` `karigar` and status `open` exists, the job reads stopped, and the sheet shows "This job is stopped. Only the owner can start it again."
  2. Given Vijay types "ok" (under 3 characters), when he sends, then the server refuses with "Say what is wrong." and nothing is stored.
  3. Given the job is stopped, when Vijay or Rajesh Verma tries to move it, then the server refuses with the stopped sentence, and the karigar has no button to clear it.
  4. Given Sanjay Seth has `decisions` open, when the problem is stored, then the owner sees it within about a second and gets the EP-11-S4 notice.
  5. Given a job that is `handed_over` or another karigar's job, when Vijay raises a problem on it, then the button is not shown, and a request sent anyway is refused or returns `not_found`.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Create Raised problem for a karigar is limited to his own open jobs (EP-20-S1). The text is required, trimmed, at least 3 characters. The problem row and the job's `stopped` flag are set in one transaction with the audit entry. Clearing a problem is Owner only and belongs to EP-24, which reuses this operation's problem row. No other roles' rules are defined here.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** Emitted after commit: "Karigar job status changed" (stopped flag true, through EP-19-S7) and "Problem raised on a job or piece" (proposed, gap G26). Consumed: "Problem cleared" (proposed, gap G26) to lift the notice when the owner clears it.
- **Audit entry written:** Yes: actor, time, entity (problem id and job id), action (`problem_raised`), after (target kind, target id, text, stopped true).
- **Data changes:** Inserts into `problems` (EP-02-S10) and sets `karigar_jobs.stopped`. Moves `RaiseProblem.tsx` with `target {kind: 'job', id}` onto the EP-08 data layer for the phone, in its large layout.
- **UI reference:** Not yet designed for the phone. The permission is drawn on `docs/ux/mockups/11-roles-and-permissions.svg` ("Raise a problem on his own job", "Anyone can stop the line. Only the owner can start it again."); the stopped colour on `docs/ux/mockups/12-state-lifecycles.svg`.
- **Non-functional checks:** Concurrency: the stop and a state change on the same job are ordered by the job version; a hand-over committed first is not undone. Audit: raised problem audited (EP-06-S7). Availability: this story needs a connection; while disconnected the button is disabled with the EP-08-S11 state and nothing is queued (D6 decided: online only). Until EP-24 ships, the owner-side clear is tested with a seeded clear.
- **Depends on:** EP-20-S3, EP-19-S6, EP-19-S7, EP-02-S10, EP-06-S2, EP-06-S7, EP-11-S4, EP-08-S5, EP-08-S17
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-20-S9: Karigar can see gold with me

- **Story ID:** EP-20-S9
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Karigar can see gold with me
- **As a:** Karigar
- **I want:** a "GOLD WITH ME" figure on my phone, with the number of jobs it covers, my wastage allowance and the line "You may be off by 500 mg either way", and a Gold tab that lists the gold per open job
- **So that:** I know how much of the shop's gold I hold and can check it against my own record (FR-20-10, BR-20-7, BR-20-9)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given Vijay Kumar · KG-04 holds two open jobs with 186.4000 g issued in total, no returns, and an allowance of 0.8%, when he opens `k-jobs`, then the header reads "GOLD WITH ME 186.4000 g" and "across 2 jobs · 0.8% wastage allowed".
  2. Given the Gold tab, when it loads, then each open job shows its job number, title and gold with him, and "You may be off by 500 mg either way" shows beside the total.
  3. Given 2.0000 g was recorded as returned on one job (EP-18-S7), when the figure is read, then it is 184.4000 g.
  4. Given Vijay has no open jobs, when the Gold tab loads, then it shows "No gold with you right now."
  5. Given Vijay calls Read Gold with me, when the server answers, then it returns only KG-04's figure, and an attempt to pass another karigar's id is ignored.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Read Gold with me is the EP-18-S11 Read Gold with karigar, called by a karigar for himself only, with the karigar id taken from the session. The figure is computed on the server in integer units of 0.0001 g. The allowance shown is the karigar record's current allowance (EP-16-S1).
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** Consumed: "Metal pool changed" and "Karigar job status changed" (own jobs) to refresh the figure.
- **Audit entry written:** No. Reading the figure changes nothing.
- **Data changes:** None in the product database. Moves `GoldTab` and `goldWithKarigar` in `src/store/selectors.ts` onto the EP-18-S11 read.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/09-karigar-phone.svg`, route `k-jobs` ("GOLD WITH ME", "186.400 g", "across 2 jobs · 0.8% wastage allowed", "You may be off by 500 mg either way"). The Gold tab itself is not yet designed (MOCKUP-COVERAGE §3). v1 shows 4 decimals.
- **Non-functional checks:** Precision: integer units, shown to 4 decimals (BR-20-9). Security: a karigar reads only his own figure. Open question: the mockup puts "You may be off by 500 mg either way" under a job's weights, while BR-20-7 puts it beside gold with me; the design pass settles where it shows.
- **Depends on:** EP-20-S1, EP-20-S3, EP-18-S11, EP-18-S12, EP-16-S1, EP-02-S2
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-20-S10a: Karigar can add a photo and a note (part 1: bench photo and typed note)

Split note: EP-20-S10 was split into S10a and S10b because the photo and typed note use existing EP-09 storage and can ship with the core flow, while the spoken note depends on the open gap G16 and brings its own storage and recognition cost (epic section 16).

- **Story ID:** EP-20-S10a
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Karigar can add a photo and a note (part 1: bench photo and typed note)
- **As a:** Karigar
- **I want:** "Add a photo (optional)" with "Take a photo of the bench", and a typed note in "Anything to tell the desk?", sent with "Send the update"
- **So that:** the desk can see the work and read what I need to tell them without a call (FR-20-8)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given MO-2026-118 is `on_bench`, when Vijay Kumar takes a photo with the phone camera and presses "Send the update", then a JobMedia row with kind `photo` links the file to the job, and the desk sees the photo on the job.
  2. Given Vijay types "Kemp stones set deep as asked" and presses "Send the update", when it commits, then `benchNote` holds the text and the desk sees it.
  3. Given a 25 MB file or a file type other than an image, when it is uploaded, then the server refuses with the EP-09-S3 message and no media row is stored.
  4. Given Vijay is signed in, when he attaches a photo to another karigar's job, then the server returns `not_found`.
  5. Given the photo button and the note field, when they are measured, then they are at least 56 px tall with text of 15 px or more.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Create Job media and Update Job note are callable by the karigar linked to the job (EP-20-S1) on jobs not handed over or cancelled. Upload, size and type checks, resizing and signed links are EP-09's (EP-09-S3, EP-09-S4, EP-09-S10). The note is trimmed and limited to 1,000 characters (proposed limit, to confirm). Media row and audit commit together.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None in the catalogue. The desk sees the photo on its next read of the job.
- **Audit entry written:** Yes: actor, time, entity (job id), action (`job_photo_added`, `job_note_updated`), after (file id, or note text).
- **Data changes:** Migration creates `job_media` (job id, file id, kind `photo` or `voice`, created at, created by). Updates `karigar_jobs.benchNote`. Adds Create Job media and Update Job note to the shared contract.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/09-karigar-phone.svg`, route `k-jobs` ("Add a photo (optional)", "Take a photo of the bench", "Anything to tell the desk?", "Send the update").
- **Non-functional checks:** Performance: the photo is resized by EP-09-S4 before the desk loads it. Personal data: photos are of the bench and the piece; they are served only to Owner, Staff and the job's karigar (EP-09-S6). Availability: photos are not queued; while disconnected the photo button is disabled with the EP-08-S11 state (D6 decided: online only).
- **Depends on:** EP-20-S3, EP-09-S1, EP-09-S3, EP-09-S4, EP-09-S6, EP-09-S10, EP-06-S2, EP-08-S11
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-20-S10b: Karigar can add a photo and a note (part 2: spoken note, G16)

Split note: EP-20-S10 was split into S10a and S10b because the photo and typed note use existing EP-09 storage and can ship with the core flow, while the spoken note depends on the open gap G16 and brings its own storage and recognition cost (epic section 16).

- **Story ID:** EP-20-S10b
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Karigar can add a photo and a note (part 2: spoken note, G16)
- **As a:** Karigar
- **I want:** the "Type or speak" control on "Anything to tell the desk?" to let me record a short spoken note and send it with the update
- **So that:** I can tell the desk something with oily hands, without typing (FR-20-8)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given MO-2026-118 is `on_bench`, when Vijay Kumar holds "Type or speak", records a 20-second note and presses "Send the update", then a JobMedia row with kind `voice` links the audio file to the job and the desk can play it.
  2. Given a recording longer than the decided limit (proposed 60 seconds), when Vijay records, then the phone stops at the limit and sends only that length.
  3. Given an audio file of a type not allowed or over the size limit, when it is uploaded, then the server refuses with the EP-09-S3 message and no media row is stored.
  4. Given the phone has no microphone permission, when Vijay taps "Type or speak", then the phone asks for it once and, if refused, keeps the typed note field working.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Same caller and job-state rules as EP-20-S10a. Allowed audio types and the size limit are added to the EP-09 allow-list. No text is produced from the audio unless G16 decides on recognition.

- **Non-functional checks:** Personal data: recordings may hold voices of people at the bench; retention follows EP-09-S12. Open question G16: whether voice notes are in scope at all, and in which languages; v1 is English only for screens, and this story stores audio without recognition. Do not build until G16 is answered.
- **Depends on:** EP-20-S10a, EP-09-S3, EP-09-S12
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-20-S11: Karigar can receive a new job live

- **Story ID:** EP-20-S11
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Karigar can receive a new job live
- **As a:** Karigar
- **I want:** a job the desk sends me to appear at the top of "My jobs" while the phone is open, and a late job to show as late, without refreshing
- **So that:** I start new work the moment it is sent and see when I am behind (FR-20-14)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given Lakshmi Devi · KG-01 has `k-jobs` open, when Rajesh Verma sends MO-2026-119 to her, then the card appears in her list within about a second without a refresh (epic acceptance criterion 5).
  2. Given Vijay Kumar · KG-04 has `k-jobs` open, when MO-2026-119 is sent to Lakshmi, then nothing changes on Vijay's phone and he receives no event.
  3. Given Lakshmi's phone lost signal while the job was sent, when it reconnects, then it shows "Reconnecting…" and then the new job, caught up from the last sequence number (EP-07-S7, EP-08-S10).
  4. Given MO-2026-121 passes its agreed date while Mahesh Soni has the phone open, when "Job passed its agreed date" arrives, then its card shows in the late colour with the days over.
  5. Given the phone app is closed, when a job is sent, then Mahesh gets the EP-11-S8 notification naming the job.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Events reach only the user channel of the karigar linked to the job (EP-07-S6). Payloads carry no customer, lead or money field (EP-19-S7). The phone refetches the job through the EP-20-S1 filtered read rather than trusting the event body.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** Consumed: "Karigar job status changed" (job sent) and "Job passed its agreed date" (proposed, gap G26, emitted by EP-19 through EP-10).
- **Audit entry written:** No. Receiving an event changes nothing.
- **Data changes:** None in the product database. Adds the karigar's event-to-read map entries for List My jobs, Read My job and Read Gold with me (EP-08-S8).
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/09-karigar-phone.svg`, route `k-jobs` ("My jobs"). The late card style is not yet designed.
- **Non-functional checks:** Performance: the new job shows within about a second of commit (PRODUCTION-SCOPE §1). Security: no event for another karigar's job. Availability: reconnecting state and catch-up after a drop.
- **Depends on:** EP-20-S3, EP-19-S7, EP-19-S9, EP-07-S6, EP-07-S7, EP-08-S8, EP-08-S9, EP-08-S10, EP-11-S8
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-20-S12a: Karigar can install the app and use it offline with a sync queue (part 1: install and open from cache) (Deferred: v1 is online only, D6)

Deferred: this story is out of scope for v1. Owner decision D6 (22 November 2026) is that karigars use the app online only, so v1 has no offline cache, no service worker and no opening the app with no signal. Owner decision D5 is that the karigar app is a React web app opened in the phone browser. Installing it to the home screen is not decided (epic section 17). The story ID, title and history are kept so the story graph stays valid. What is deferred: the web app manifest and icons, the service worker that cached the app shell and the karigar's own reads, and the cached "last updated" view of jobs. The connection-lost state of EP-08-S11 stays in v1.

- **Story ID:** EP-20-S12a
- **Status:** Deferred: v1 is online only, no offline cache or queue (D6).
- **Title:** Karigar can install the app and use it offline with a sync queue (part 1: install and open from cache) (Deferred: v1 is online only, D6)
- **As a:** Karigar
- **I want:** Deferred: no home-screen install and no use of cached jobs with no signal in v1; the app is a React web app used online in the phone browser (D5, D6)
- **So that:** Deferred: the original purpose was checking a job's weights with no signal; v1 shows the connection-lost state instead (FR-20-1 install clause and FR-20-13, both Deferred, D6)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given Vijay Kumar has the app open in the phone browser, when the phone loses signal, then the EP-08-S11 connection-lost state is shown, what is already on screen stays visible and read-only, and every action that needs the server is disabled with a reason until the connection returns.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** None new. Deferred: the cache of the karigar's own reads is not built; every read is the EP-20-S1 filtered read, made online.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None of its own. On reconnect, catch-up runs as in EP-20-S11.
- **Audit entry written:** No. Nothing changes on the server.
- **Data changes:** None. Deferred: the web app manifest, icons and service worker are not built in v1; nothing about the jobs is stored on the phone.
- **UI reference:** Deferred: no install or cached-jobs screen in v1. Base screen is `docs/ux/mockups/09-karigar-phone.svg`, route `k-jobs`; the connection-lost state is EP-08-S11.
- **Non-functional checks:** Availability: with no signal the app shows the EP-08-S11 state and does not open from cache (D6). Personal data: the phone keeps no copy of the karigar's jobs beyond the open page. Decided: D5 (React web app in the phone browser) and D6 (online only). Open question: whether the app should be installable to the home screen (epic section 17).
- **Depends on:** EP-20-S2, EP-20-S3, EP-20-S9, EP-08-S2, EP-08-S11, EP-08-S15, EP-01-S12
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-20-S12b: Karigar can install the app and use it offline with a sync queue (part 2: offline queue and sync) (Deferred: v1 is online only, D6)

Deferred: this story is out of scope for v1. Owner decision D6 (22 November 2026) is that karigars use the app online only. There is no offline queue, no on-device queue of updates, no "Sync Queued updates" operation and no replay of queued updates. The story ID, title and history are kept so the story graph stays valid, and its dependency on EP-20-S12a is kept (deferred too). What is deferred: the Sync Queued updates operation, the on-device queue (JobUpdate), idempotent replay in client order, and the refusal handling after sync (the old D6 side question). In v1 a karigar update is sent when it is tapped. With no signal the EP-08-S11 state shows and the buttons are disabled with a reason.

- **Story ID:** EP-20-S12b
- **Status:** Deferred: v1 is online only, no offline cache or queue (D6).
- **Title:** Karigar can install the app and use it offline with a sync queue (part 2: offline queue and sync) (Deferred: v1 is online only, D6)
- **As a:** Karigar
- **I want:** Deferred: no offline queue in v1; each update is sent when I tap it, and with no signal the buttons are disabled with a reason (D6)
- **So that:** Deferred: the original purpose was that weak signal never loses an update; in v1 an update that cannot be sent is refused with a reason and is never held back or lost silently (FR-20-12 and FR-20-13, both Deferred, D6)

Given MO-2026-118 is `on_bench` and the phone has no signal, when Vijay Kumar looks at "Ready for checking", then the EP-08-S11 connection-lost state is shown, the button is disabled with a reason, nothing is queued on the phone, and when the connection returns the live channel catches up (EP-07-S7).
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Deferred: no Sync operation in v1. Each update goes through the same operations and checks as EP-20-S4 to EP-20-S6, one call at a time, with the version check on the job.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None of its own. Events come from the operations of EP-20-S4 to EP-20-S6.
- **Audit entry written:** None of its own. Each operation of EP-20-S4 to EP-20-S6 is audited by its own story.
- **Data changes:** None. Deferred: the Sync Queued updates operation, the on-device queue (JobUpdate) and the service worker cache are not built in v1; nothing is stored on the device.
- **UI reference:** Deferred: no sync status screen in v1. Buttons are on `docs/ux/mockups/09-karigar-phone.svg`, route `k-jobs`; the connection-lost state is EP-08-S11.

- **Depends on:** EP-20-S12a, EP-20-S4, EP-20-S5, EP-20-S6, EP-20-S10a, EP-03-S8, EP-04-S12, EP-08-S6

## EP-20-S13: Karigar can hand over several jobs at once (G14)

- **Story ID:** EP-20-S13
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Karigar can hand over several jobs at once (G14)
- **As a:** Karigar
- **I want:** to pick several of my `ready` jobs and send them to the showroom in one hand-over that creates one arriving parcel
- **So that:** when I bring a day's work in one packet, the desk weighs it as one parcel, as mockup 12 shows ("One handover can carry many jobs.")
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given Vijay Kumar has MO-2026-118 and MO-2026-122 both `ready`, when he selects both and taps "Sent to the showroom", then both jobs are `handed_over` and one new parcel BATCH-2026-NNN references both jobs.
  2. Given one of the selected jobs is `on_bench` or stopped, when the request reaches the server, then the whole hand-over is refused with that job's sentence and no job moves and no parcel is created.
  3. Given the selection includes another karigar's job id, when the server checks it, then it returns `not_found` and nothing changes.
  4. Given Rajesh Verma has `parcels` open, when the hand-over commits, then one parcel appears listing both job numbers.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Every job in the hand-over must belong to the session's karigar, be `ready` and not stopped. All jobs, the parcel and the audit entries commit or roll back together. Idempotency key and version checks per job as in EP-20-S6.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** Emitted after commit: "Karigar job status changed" for each job and one "Parcel handed over by karigar".
- **Audit entry written:** Yes: actor, time, entity (each job id and the parcel id), action (`job_handed_over`, `parcel_created`), after (parcel id, list of job ids).
- **Data changes:** Needs a parcel-to-job link that holds many jobs (for example a `parcel_jobs` table) in place of the single `Parcel.jobId`; the migration is defined with EP-02 when G14 is decided.
- **UI reference:** Not yet designed. The rule is drawn on `docs/ux/mockups/12-state-lifecycles.svg` ("One handover can carry many jobs.").
- **Non-functional checks:** Concurrency: all jobs locked in a fixed order (by job id) to avoid deadlock with a stop. Open question G14: can one hand-over carry several jobs; the data model has a single `Parcel.jobId`. Do not build until G14 is answered; the per-job settlement split is an EP-19-S12 open question.
- **Depends on:** EP-20-S6, EP-02-S6, EP-03-S6, EP-03-S8, EP-19-S7
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## Open questions affecting these stories

Copied from the epic's section 17. Not answered here.

- D5 is decided: the karigar app is a React web app opened in the phone browser ([decision record](../decisions/D5-D6-karigar-app.md)). (EP-20-S2)
- D6 is decided: online only, with no offline mode in v1 ([decision record](../decisions/D5-D6-karigar-app.md)). EP-20-S12a and EP-20-S12b are deferred. (EP-20-S10a, S12a, S12b)
- Should the karigar app be installable to the home screen? It needs only a web app manifest and icons, no offline support. (EP-20-S12a)
- D4 is decided: phone and password; phone numbers are unique, so a karigar cannot sign in on a shared phone number (EP-20-S1, S2).
- G14: can one hand-over carry several jobs (mockup 12)? (EP-20-S6, S13)
- G16: are bench voice notes ("Type or speak") in scope, and in which languages? (EP-20-S10b)
- Should the karigar see the due date the desk asked for after confirming their own? (EP-20-S3, S4)

# EP-21: Parcel intake and tagging · stories

Epic document: [EP-21 Parcel intake and tagging](../epics/EP-21-parcel-intake-and-tagging.md)

Role note: stories where the server checks, locks, pushes or records on its own use "System". The parcel is created by the karigar's hand-over (EP-20-S6); the match verdict, release, send-back of a whole parcel and owner re-check belong to EP-23, and raising and clearing problems to EP-24. Where those epics are not built yet, the stories here are tested with seeded stopped and re-checking parcels. No weight is ever pre-filled, and no price or value appears on these screens (the piece value socket stays empty until EP-42).

---

## EP-21-S1: System can store parcels, weighings, manifests, pieces and checks as integer weights

- **Story ID:** EP-21-S1
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** System can store parcels, weighings, manifests, pieces and checks as integer weights
- **As a:** System
- **I want:** the intake fields this epic needs on top of the EP-02 tables: a three-part quality check per piece (scale agrees, hallmark, deductions, by, at), the tray weighing a piece was weighed in, the scale and tagger on each piece, and the tag-return fields, with every weight stored as an integer in units of 0.0001 g
- **So that:** arrival, tags and checks survive a reload and a redeploy, and the gold sums are exact (BR-21-10, FR-21-10, FR-21-18)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given a weighing "Whole parcel" on the Bench balance with gross 485.5000 g and stones 38.2000 g, when it is saved and read back, then `parcel_weighings` stores `4855000` and `382000`, and the net 447.3000 g is computed on read, not stored from the client.
  2. Given a piece TAG-9108 with gross 84.5000 g, stones 6.1000 g and scale Bench balance, weighed in "Tray 3", when it is saved, then `pieces` stores `845000`, `61000`, the scale id, the tray weighing id, `taggedBy` and `taggedAt`, and the value field stays null.
  3. Given a quality check row for TAG-9110 on BATCH-2026-043, when it is stored, then it holds `scaleAgrees`, `hallmark` and `deductions` as booleans with the user id and time, and a second row for the same parcel and piece is rejected by the EP-02-S6 unique key.
  4. Given a piece whose tray weighing id points to a weighing on another parcel, when it is written, then the database rejects it, because a tray link must name a weighing of the piece's own parcel.
  5. Given the migration runs on a staging copy loaded with the prototype seed (EP-02-S13), when it finishes, then existing pieces have a null tray link, existing QC ticks are carried over as checks with all three parts true, and the migration can be rolled back.
  6. Given a parcel arrives and is weighed in three trays, when the parcel, its weighings and its tagged pieces are stored, then each row carries `location_id` set by the server to the shop's default location "Main shop"; a location sent by the client is ignored (D7).
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Weights are integers in units of 0.0001 g with gross greater than 0 and stones from 0 up to gross (check constraints). Net is never stored from client input. The tray link is nullable and must reference a weighing of the same parcel. One quality check row per parcel and piece. `version` columns on `parcels` and `pieces` back the EP-02-S14 stale-write check.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None. This story only stores data.
- **Audit entry written:** No. Schema changes are tracked by the migration history (EP-02-S1); data changes are audited by EP-21-S14.
- **Data changes:** Migration adds to `parcel_qc_ticks` (or renames it `parcel_qc_checks`) the columns `scaleAgrees`, `hallmark`, `deductions`, `checkedBy`, `checkedAt`; adds to `pieces` the columns `scaleId`, `trayWeighingId` (nullable), `taggedBy`, `taggedAt`, `retagRequestedBy`, `retagRequestedAt`, `retagReason` (nullable); adds `poRef` (nullable) to `parcels` if EP-02-S6 did not. Presence is not stored here; it lives in the live channel (EP-07-S8). Uses the `location_id` columns on `parcels`, `parcel_weighings` and `pieces` from EP-02-S5 and EP-02-S6.
- **UI reference:** No screen.
- **Non-functional checks:** Precision: every weight is an integer in units of 0.0001 g, shown to 4 decimals; gap G10 (the half-step in the ceiling) must be settled in EP-02 before this migration. Time: `arrivedAt`, `taggedAt` and `checkedAt` stored in UTC. Open question G15: the tray link shape (one tray per piece) is the proposed answer; a different answer changes this migration.
- **Depends on:** EP-02-S1, EP-02-S2, EP-02-S5, EP-02-S6, EP-02-S13, EP-02-S14, EP-14-S1
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-21-S2: Staff can record a parcel's arrival with scale and manifest

- **Story ID:** EP-21-S2
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Staff can record a parcel's arrival with scale and manifest
- **As a:** Staff
- **I want:** on `parcel-arrival`, to pick "Which scale is this on?", type "Everything on the scale together" and "Of that, the stones, pearls, lac — anything not gold", see "SO THE PURE GOLD IN THIS PARCEL IS", list the kinds and counts inside, and press "Open the parcel for tagging"
- **So that:** the parcel's three weights and contents are fixed before anyone tags, and every tag will be checked against them (FR-21-1, FR-21-2, FR-21-4, BR-21-3, BR-21-4)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given parcel BATCH-2026-044 from Mahesh Soni against MO-2026-118 has no weighings, when Rajesh Verma picks "Bench balance · 0.0001 g", types 485.5000 and 38.2000, lists Temple Haram · Chettinad, Kundan Choker, Polki Kada · pair and Meenakari Pendant with counts adding to 12, and presses "Open the parcel for tagging", then the parcel has one weighing, four manifest rows, `stage` 2, and the button reads "Start tagging · 0 of 12" (epic acceptance criterion 1).
  2. Given the weight fields, when the screen opens, then both are empty and the pure gold line shows nothing until both are typed, then "447.3000 g" with "485.5000 − 38.2000".
  3. Given Rajesh types stones 490.0000 against gross 485.5000, when he saves, then the server refuses with "Stones cannot weigh more than the whole parcel." and nothing is stored; with no scale picked it refuses with "Pick the scale this was weighed on."; with no gross, "Enter what the parcel weighs on the scale."; with no rows, "List what is inside the parcel."
  4. Given rows are added with "Add another kind of item", when the counts change, then the line "That is N items to tag in the next step" updates from the rows, and there is no field for a total (FR-21-4).
  5. Given BATCH-2026-044 is already weighed, when a second arrival request reaches the server, then it refuses with "This parcel has already been weighed." and `parcel-arrival` shows "BATCH-2026-044 is already weighed" with its saved figures.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Staff or Owner only (EP-05-S2). At least one weighing, each on a registered, active scale (EP-14-S1) with gross greater than 0 and stones from 0 to gross. At least one manifest row with a kind from the active category list (EP-15-S4) and a count of at least 1. Allowed only on an `open` parcel with no weighings. Arrival time and actor come from the server (EP-03-S3). Parcel update, rows and audit commit together (EP-03-S6). Version check on the parcel. A weight above the scale's capacity returns the EP-14-S11 warning.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** Consumed: "Parcel handed over by karigar" so the parcel appears ready to weigh. Emitted: none from the catalogue; the parcels-in list refreshes through the `parcel:<id>` entity channel (EP-08-S9).
- **Audit entry written:** Yes: actor, time, entity (parcel id), action (`parcel_arrival_recorded`), after (each weighing's label, scale id, gross and stones in integer units, each manifest row's kind and count).
- **Data changes:** Inserts rows into `parcel_weighings` and `parcel_manifest_rows`; updates `parcels.stage`, `poRef` and `version`. Ports `recordParcelArrival` from `src/store/transitions.ts` as a server service function and moves `ParcelArrival.tsx` onto the EP-08 data layer.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/20-parcel-arrival.svg`, route `parcel-arrival` ("Weigh the parcel and list what is in it", "WEIGH THE WHOLE PARCEL · ALL THREE FIGURES", "Which scale is this on?", "SAY WHAT IS INSIDE · MIXED IS FINE", "Add another kind of item", "That is 12 items to tag in the next step", "Open the parcel for tagging").
- **Non-functional checks:** Precision: weights typed to 4 decimals and converted with the EP-02-S2 helper; the pure gold line uses the same helper on client and server. Concurrency: two staff weighing the same parcel get one success and one "This parcel has already been weighed." Audit: arrival audited, which the prototype does not do. Time: arrival time in UTC, shown in Asia/Kolkata. Open decision D9: weights are typed by hand here; reading them from the balance is EP-36. D7 is decided: the parcel carries the shop ID, not a branch.
- **Depends on:** EP-21-S1, EP-20-S6, EP-03-S3, EP-03-S6, EP-05-S2, EP-14-S9, EP-14-S11, EP-15-S4, EP-15-S5, EP-06-S2, EP-08-S5, EP-08-S9, EP-08-S17
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-21-S3: Staff can weigh a parcel in trays

- **Story ID:** EP-21-S3
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Staff can weigh a parcel in trays
- **As a:** Staff
- **I want:** on `parcel-arrival`, to choose "Weigh it in trays", enter each tray as its own weighing with "Which scale is this tray on?", gross and stones, add or remove trays before tagging, and see the trays summed
- **So that:** a parcel too heavy for the bench balance is still weighed finely, and a gap can later be pinned to one tray (FR-21-3, BR-21-3, G15)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given a 10 kg parcel, when Rajesh Verma enters 20 trays, each on the Bench balance, and saves, then the parcel has 20 weighings labelled "Tray 1" to "Tray 20" in that order, each with its own scale id, and the parcel totals are the sum of the trays.
  2. Given Tray 1 on the Platform scale and Tray 2 on the Bench balance, when they are saved, then each weighing keeps its own scale, and the ceiling later counts ½ × 0.01 g for Tray 1 and ½ × 0.0001 g for Tray 2 (EP-14-S10).
  3. Given Tray 14 has stones 120.0000 g against gross 95.0000 g, when Rajesh saves, then the server refuses with "Tray 14: the stones cannot weigh more than everything together." and nothing is stored.
  4. Given a weighed parcel with no tags yet, when Rajesh adds Tray 21 through Update Parcel arrival, then it is stored as one more weighing; once any tag is saved, the server refuses with "Tagging has started. Weighings can no longer change." (proposed wording).
  5. Given a tray above the scale's capacity of 600 g on the Bench balance, when it is typed, then the EP-14-S11 capacity warning shows beside that tray.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Same checks as EP-21-S2 for each tray. Labels are assigned by the server as "Tray N" in position order. Update Parcel arrival is Staff only and allowed only while the parcel is open and has no pieces. Version check on the parcel so two staff adding trays do not overwrite each other.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None from the catalogue. Other screens on the parcel refresh through the `parcel:<id>` entity channel.
- **Audit entry written:** Yes: actor, time, entity (parcel id), action (`parcel_arrival_recorded` or `parcel_weighing_added`), before (weighing count), after (each tray's label, scale id, gross and stones).
- **Data changes:** Inserts `parcel_weighings` rows with position. No new tables.
- **UI reference:** Not yet designed (MOCKUP-COVERAGE §3, tray entry). The rule is drawn on `docs/ux/mockups/14-match-rule-any-parcel.svg` ("The same 10 kg, in trays", "20 trays on 0.0001 g") and noted on `docs/ux/mockups/20-parcel-arrival.svg` ("A parcel too heavy for this balance is weighed in trays"); the prototype route is `parcel-arrival`.
- **Non-functional checks:** Precision: tray sums in integer units, no rounding. Performance: a 20-tray arrival saves in one request and its echo arrives within about 1 second. Open question Q5c: the largest and smallest parcels, which sets the tray limit per parcel. Open question G15: trays per piece are linked in EP-21-S6.
- **Depends on:** EP-21-S2, EP-14-S10, EP-14-S11, EP-02-S14
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-21-S4: Staff can receive a parcel with no job

- **Story ID:** EP-21-S4
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Staff can receive a parcel with no job
- **As a:** Staff
- **I want:** to start `parcel-arrival` without a hand-over, pick the karigar it came from and type a PO reference such as PO-2026-915, then weigh and list it as usual
- **So that:** work that arrives without a job on the system, such as an order placed by phone, still enters the gold record (FR-21-5)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given no hand-over, when Rajesh Verma opens a new arrival, picks Mahesh Soni, types PO-2026-915, weighs and lists it, then a new parcel BATCH-2026-NNN exists with that karigar, `jobId` empty, `poRef` "PO-2026-915", `stage` 2 and `arrivedAt` from the server clock.
  2. Given no karigar is picked, when he saves, then the server refuses with "Say which karigar it came from." and nothing is stored.
  3. Given the karigar picker, when it opens, then it lists only active karigars (EP-16-S8), and a request naming an inactive karigar is refused.
  4. Given the PO reference is left blank, when he saves, then the parcel is stored with `poRef` empty and the subtitle reads "Weigh the whole thing first, then say what is inside" with no job line.
  5. Given two arrivals saved at the same moment, when both commit, then they get two different parcel ids with no gap and no duplicate.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Staff or Owner only. Karigar must be active. The parcel id is the next `BATCH-YYYY-NNN` from the same counter used by EP-20-S6. PO reference is trimmed and limited to 40 characters (proposed limit). All EP-21-S2 weighing and manifest rules apply. Create and audit in one transaction; deduplicated by idempotency key (EP-03-S8).
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None from the catalogue; the hand-over event is not emitted because the karigar did not hand over. The parcels-in list refreshes through the entity channel.
- **Audit entry written:** Yes: actor, time, entity (parcel id), action (`parcel_created_without_job`), after (karigar id, PO reference, weighings, manifest).
- **Data changes:** Inserts into `parcels`, `parcel_weighings` and `parcel_manifest_rows`.
- **UI reference:** No mockup for the no-job case; the prototype adds a karigar picker and "PO-2026-915" field to `parcel-arrival` (`docs/ux/mockups/20-parcel-arrival.svg` shows the job case).
- **Non-functional checks:** Concurrency: the parcel id counter is atomic. Security: only Staff and Owner; a karigar cannot create a parcel this way. Audit: creation without a job is audited so the owner can see who brought it in.
- **Depends on:** EP-21-S2, EP-16-S8, EP-03-S7, EP-03-S8
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-21-S5: System can enforce the tagging rules on the server

- **Story ID:** EP-21-S5
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** System can enforce the tagging rules on the server
- **As a:** System
- **I want:** every Create Tag and Update Tag to check, inside one transaction, that the parcel is weighed and not stopped or released, the tag number is free, the stones are not above the gross, the scale is registered, and the kind is on the manifest with room left
- **So that:** no bad tag reaches the gold record, even when several staff save at once (FR-21-6, FR-21-7, FR-21-8, FR-21-9, BR-21-9)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given BATCH-2026-045 has no weighings, when a tag is saved on it, then the server refuses with "Weigh the parcel before tagging."
  2. Given TAG-8841 is on a piece of BATCH-2026-041, when a tag TAG-8841 is saved on BATCH-2026-044, then the server refuses with "TAG-8841 is already used on another piece." (epic acceptance criterion 2).
  3. Given Polki Kada · pair has count 4 on the manifest and 4 are tagged, when a fifth is saved, then the server refuses with "All 4 Polki Kada · pair on the list are already tagged."; a kind not on the list is refused with "<kind> is not on this parcel's list." (epic acceptance criterion 4).
  4. Given 3 of 4 Kundan Choker are tagged and two staff save the fourth and a fifth at the same moment, when both requests run, then exactly one succeeds and the other is refused with the count sentence.
  5. Given a tag with stones 9.0000 g on gross 8.0000 g, gross 0, no name, no tag number or no scale, when it is saved, then the server refuses with "Stones cannot weigh more than the piece.", "Enter what the piece weighs on the scale.", "Name the piece.", "Give the piece a tag number." or "Pick the scale this piece was weighed on." respectively.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Staff only for Create Tag; Staff, and Owner on a re-check, for Update Tag (EP-05-S2). The manifest count check and the tag number check run inside the save transaction with the parcel row locked. Tag number and HUID checks are EP-15-S7 and EP-15-S8. Purity, kind and style must be active list entries (EP-15-S4). The server never fills a weight; a missing gross is refused, not defaulted (BR-21-1). Stopped and released rules are EP-21-S13.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None. Refused saves emit nothing; accepted saves emit through EP-21-S6.
- **Audit entry written:** No. Refused saves store nothing; accepted saves are audited by EP-21-S14.
- **Data changes:** None beyond EP-21-S1. Ports the `saveTag` checks from `src/store/transitions.ts` as a server service function with a row lock on the parcel.
- **UI reference:** No screen. The sentences show on `docs/ux/mockups/21-tag-one-item.svg`, route `parcel-tag`, through EP-08-S5.
- **Non-functional checks:** Concurrency: two staff saving the same tag number get one success and one clear refusal; a manifest count cannot be exceeded by two saves at once (epic section 13). Precision: the stones-above-gross check compares integer units.
- **Depends on:** EP-21-S1, EP-21-S2, EP-15-S4, EP-15-S7, EP-15-S8, EP-03-S4, EP-03-S6, EP-05-S2
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-21-S6: Staff can tag one item with nothing pre-filled

- **Story ID:** EP-21-S6
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Staff can tag one item with nothing pre-filled
- **As a:** Staff
- **I want:** "Tag item 8 of 12" on `parcel-tag` with "Kind of item" picked from the manifest, a suggested "New tag number" and HUID, name, purity, size, collection, style, stone count, the tray, and the weights "On the scale now" and "Stones, kemp, lac on this piece" typed fresh, then "Save tag · go to item 9" or "Save and stop here"
- **So that:** each piece is recorded with its own measured weight on a named scale, counted towards the parcel (FR-21-9, FR-21-10, BR-21-1, BR-21-2, BR-21-5)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given BATCH-2026-044 with 7 of 12 tagged, when Rajesh Verma opens `parcel-tag`, then the header reads "Tag item 8 of 12", "New tag number" shows the reserved TAG-9108, both weight fields are empty, and the side panel lists "STILL TO TAG" with "Temple Haram · 1 left".
  2. Given Rajesh picks Temple Haram · Chettinad, enters HUID 4T71M9, name "Chettinad Temple Nakshi Long Haram", purity 22K (916), size 28 inches, tray "Tray 3", weights 84.5000 and 6.1000 on the Bench balance, and presses "Save tag · go to item 9", then a `draft` piece TAG-9108 is stored with those values, "PURE GOLD IN THIS PIECE 78.4000 g" was shown, and the form opens item 9 with empty weights.

  4. Given "Save and stop here", when the tag saves, then Rajesh returns to the parcel and the progress reads "8 of 12 items tagged so far", counted in pieces, with "pure gold so far" summed from saved tags (BR-21-2).

The tray must be a weighing of this parcel when the parcel was weighed in trays, and is empty otherwise. Piece status is `draft`; `taggedBy`, `taggedAt`, `jobId` and `madeById` come from the server and the parcel. Version check on the piece when it already exists. The parcel's stage and verdict are recomputed in the same transaction.

- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/21-tag-one-item.svg`, route `parcel-tag` ("Tag item 8 of 12", "Kind of item", "picked from the manifest · 1 of these still to tag", "New tag number", "Hallmark HUID", "WHAT IT WEIGHS · ON THE SAME BENCH BALANCE", "On the scale now", "PURE GOLD IN THIS PIECE", "Save tag · go to item 9", "Save and stop here", "WHY NOTHING IS PRE-FILLED").
- **Non-functional checks:** Precision: weights typed to 4 decimals, stored as integer units; net computed with the shared helper. Performance: a save and its live echo arrive within about 1 second. Concurrency: see EP-21-S5. Open decision D9: weights typed by hand; reading from the balance is EP-36. Open question: how carats are converted to grams for stones (the "itemise →" link); until answered, stones are entered in grams.
- **Depends on:** EP-21-S3, EP-21-S5, EP-15-S5, EP-15-S6, EP-14-S9, EP-07-S1, EP-07-S11, EP-08-S5, EP-08-S6, EP-08-S17
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-21-S8: Staff can run the three quality checks

- **Story ID:** EP-21-S8
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Staff can run the three quality checks
- **As a:** Staff
- **I want:** on `parcel-qc`, for each tagged piece, to answer "Does the scale agree?" by typing "You re-weigh", "Is the hallmark on the piece?" and "Do the deductions look honest?", then press "Checked — on to piece 5"
- **So that:** every piece is checked by a staff member before the parcel can be matched and released, with no separate QC role (FR-21-12, BR-21-6, BR-21-7, BR-21-8)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given TAG-9110 "Jadau Uncut Emerald Cocktail Ring" with "Tag says 14.8500 g", when Rajesh Verma types 14.8500 in "You re-weigh", then "Matches" shows; if he types 14.8300, then "Differs by 20 mg. Send the tag back to be weighed again." shows and "Checked" stays disabled.
  2. Given all three answers are yes, when Rajesh presses "Checked — on to piece 5", then a check row with `scaleAgrees`, `hallmark` and `deductions` true, his user id and the server time is stored, the header reads "4 of 9 pieces checked", and piece 5 opens.
  3. Given a check request with any of the three parts false, when it reaches the server, then it refuses with "Confirm all three checks first." (proposed wording) and nothing is stored.
  4. Given BATCH-2026-043 has 8 of 9 pieces checked, when a release is attempted (EP-23), then it is refused with "Check every piece before releasing the parcel." (BR-21-8).
  5. Given the same check is sent twice, when the server processes it, then one check row exists and the second call returns success without change.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Staff or Owner only; no QC role exists (BR-21-6). The piece must belong to the parcel ("<tag> is not in this parcel."). The re-weigh must equal the tag gross in integer units for "scale agrees" to be accepted. Not allowed on a stopped or released parcel (EP-21-S13). One check row per parcel and piece. The release check itself is in EP-23.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None from the catalogue; other screens on the parcel refresh the checked count through the `parcel:<id>` entity channel.
- **Audit entry written:** Yes: actor, time, entity (piece tag number and parcel id), action (`qc_checked`), after (scale agrees, hallmark, deductions, re-weigh in integer units).
- **Data changes:** Inserts into the quality check table (EP-21-S1). Ports `qcTick` and moves `QcCheck.tsx` onto the EP-08 data layer.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/07-qc-check.svg`, route `parcel-qc` ("Check this piece before the parcel is matched", "THREE THINGS TO CONFIRM", "Does the scale agree?", "You re-weigh", "Is the hallmark on the piece?", "Do the deductions look honest?", "Checked — on to piece 5", "There is no separate QC manager.").
- **Non-functional checks:** Precision: the re-weigh comparison is exact in integer units. Audit: each check is audited, which the prototype does not do. Open question: the lac warning "Rings this size usually carry 0.6–0.9 g of lac" needs a stored norm per kind; until one exists, the line is not shown.
- **Depends on:** EP-21-S6, EP-21-S7, EP-05-S2, EP-03-S8, EP-08-S17
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-21-S9: Staff can send a tag back for re-tag

- **Story ID:** EP-21-S9
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Staff can send a tag back for re-tag
- **As a:** Staff
- **I want:** "Send this tag back to Deepak" on `parcel-qc`, with an optional reason, which marks the piece for re-tag by the person who tagged it, clears its check and opens it on `parcel-tag` for whoever picks it up
- **So that:** a piece whose weight or deductions look wrong is weighed again before the parcel is matched (FR-21-11, FR-21-13)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given TAG-9110 was tagged by Deepak Rao and checked, when Rajesh Verma presses "Send this tag back to Deepak" with reason "Re-weigh, scale differs by 20 mg", then the piece's check row is removed, `retagRequestedBy` is Rajesh, the reason is stored, and the checked count drops by one.
  2. Given Deepak Rao has BATCH-2026-043 open, when the send-back commits, then he sees TAG-9110 marked "Sent back by Rajesh Verma" within about a second.
  3. Given TAG-9110 is re-tagged with gross 14.8300 g, when it saves, then the re-tag fields are cleared, the piece needs checking again, and the audit shows before 14.8500 g and after 14.8300 g (epic acceptance criterion 5).
  4. Given a re-tag is opened, when `parcel-tag` loads, then the existing tag number, kind and text fields are shown, and the weight fields are empty to be read again.
  5. Given the parcel is stopped or released, when a send-back request reaches the server, then it refuses with the stopped or released sentence.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Staff or Owner only. The piece must be `draft` and belong to the parcel. Reason is optional, trimmed, up to 300 characters (proposed limit). Any tag save on a piece clears its check (FR-21-11), whether or not it was sent back. Version check on the piece.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** Emitted after commit: "Tag saved on a shared parcel" with a sent-back flag, so other staff see the piece reopened.
- **Audit entry written:** Yes: actor, time, entity (piece tag number and parcel id), action (`tag_sent_back`), before (checked), after (re-tag requested, reason, named tagger).
- **Data changes:** Updates `pieces.retagRequestedBy`, `retagRequestedAt`, `retagReason`, `version`; deletes the piece's check row.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/07-qc-check.svg`, route `parcel-qc` ("Send this tag back to Deepak"); re-tag opens on route `parcel-tag`. The "Sent back" marker is not yet designed.
- **Non-functional checks:** Concurrency: a send-back and a check on the same piece are ordered by the piece version. Audit: before and after weights kept on the re-tag. Open question: whether the named tagger also gets a notice (EP-11) is not decided; this story shows it only on screen.
- **Depends on:** EP-21-S6, EP-21-S8, EP-07-S11, EP-08-S9

## EP-21-S13: System can freeze tagging when a parcel stops

- **Story ID:** EP-21-S13
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** System can freeze tagging when a parcel stops
- **As a:** System
- **I want:** to refuse new tags, re-tags, checks and send-backs on a stopped parcel, except a re-tag of the one piece the owner asked to re-check, and to freeze the open tag and check forms live when the parcel stops
- **So that:** nothing changes on a parcel the owner must look at, and staff see that at once (FR-21-16)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given BATCH-2026-044 is stopped, when Rajesh Verma opens `parcel-tag`, then every field and save button is disabled and the notice reads "This parcel is stopped. Only the owner can start it again." (epic acceptance criterion 6).
  2. Given Rajesh has the tag form open, when the parcel stops through "Parcel stopped (mismatch or raised problem)", then within about a second his form freezes with the same notice and his unsaved values stay visible; on `parcel-qc` it reads "This parcel is stopped, so checks are paused."
  3. Given a tag, check or send-back request on a stopped parcel, when it reaches the server, then it refuses with "This parcel is stopped. Only the owner can start it again."; on a released parcel, "This parcel has been released."
  4. Given the owner asked to re-check TAG-9108 (parcel `resolution` `rechecking`, `recheckPieceId` TAG-9108), when Rajesh re-tags TAG-9108, then the save is accepted, and a save of any other piece is refused with the stopped sentence.
  5. Given the re-check save commits, when the server recomputes the parcel, then `resolution` and `recheckPieceId` are cleared and the parcel stays stopped or reopens as the verdict decides (EP-23).
- **Rules enforced on the server:** The stop check runs inside each save, check and send-back transaction against the locked parcel row. Only the piece named in `recheckPieceId` may be re-tagged while stopped, and only an Update Tag, not a new tag. The verdict and stop are set by EP-23 and EP-24; this story only obeys them.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** Consumed: "Parcel stopped (mismatch or raised problem)" to freeze the form.
- **Audit entry written:** No for refused requests, which store nothing. The accepted re-check save is audited by EP-21-S14 with action `tag_rechecked`.
- **Data changes:** None beyond EP-21-S1. Ports the stopped and re-check branches of `saveTag` and the stopped check of `qcTick`.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/21-tag-one-item.svg`, route `parcel-tag` (frozen state not yet designed); `docs/ux/mockups/07-qc-check.svg`, route `parcel-qc`; stopped colour on `docs/ux/mockups/12-state-lifecycles.svg`.
- **Non-functional checks:** Concurrency: a save already committed before the stop is kept; a save that reaches the lock after the stop is refused. Performance: the form freezes within about 1 second of the stop. Open question G15: a stop on one tray only, so the rest can keep moving, needs the tray link from EP-21-S1 and a rule from EP-23; until then a stop freezes the whole parcel. Until EP-23 and EP-24 exist, stops and re-checks are seeded for tests.
- **Depends on:** EP-21-S5, EP-21-S6, EP-21-S8, EP-21-S9, EP-07-S11, EP-08-S9
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

# EP-22: Stock and piece lifecycle · stories

Epic document: [EP-22 Stock and piece lifecycle](../epics/EP-22-stock-and-piece-lifecycle.md)

Role note: stories where the server stores, checks, locks or pushes on its own use "System". The state machine here is called by other epics: release (EP-23), stop and clear (EP-24), edit apply (EP-25), sale (EP-26) and scrap (EP-27). Where those epics are not built yet, the stories here are tested by calling the transition service directly and with seeded stopped, billed and scrapped pieces. v1 has no holds, so no story here reserves a piece for a customer or a lead. No price or value is shown; the value socket stays empty until EP-42. Weights are shown to 4 decimals; mockup 03 prints 3 decimals, and the figures below are its numbers written to 4.

---

## EP-22-S1: System can store pieces with state, version and integer weights

- **Story ID:** EP-22-S1
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** System can store pieces with state, version and integer weights
- **As a:** System
- **I want:** the piece lifecycle fields on top of the EP-02 and EP-21 piece table: `status` limited to the six states, `prevStatus`, `inStockAt`, `soldAt`, `stockOutId`, `version`, gross and stone weights as integers in units of 0.0001 g, the nullable value socket, and a `piece_state_transitions` table, with no held-for or hold-expiry field
- **So that:** every piece's state and weights survive a reload and a redeploy, and the server has one place to read and lock a piece before changing it (BR-22-1, BR-22-4, BR-22-9)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given the migration has run, when `pieces` is inspected, then `status` accepts only `draft`, `with_owner`, `stopped`, `in_stock`, `billed` and `scrapped`, and a write of `held` is rejected by the database check constraint.
  2. Given piece TAG-8841 with gross 48.6500 g and stones 7.0600 g, when it is saved and read back, then `pieces` stores `486500` and `70600`, the pure gold 41.5900 g is computed on read, and the value field is null.
  3. Given the migration has run, when `pieces` is inspected, then there is no `heldForLeadId` column and no hold-expiry column, and `piece_state_transitions` has piece id, from, to, actor, at and reason.
  4. Given the prototype seed is loaded into staging (EP-02-S13), when the migration runs, then every seeded piece with `heldForLeadId` set is stored as `in_stock` with no link to the lead, every other piece keeps its state, and the migration can be rolled back.
  5. Given a piece with `status` `stopped`, when it is saved with `prevStatus` empty, then the database rejects it, because a stopped piece must record the state it returns to.
  6. Given any piece in stock, when it is read, then it carries `location_id` "Main shop" (EP-02-S5); no state transition or operation changes the location in v1, because transfers between locations are deferred (D7).
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Status is one of six values (check constraint). `prevStatus` is required when status is `stopped` and empty otherwise. Gross is greater than 0 and stones are from 0 up to gross. Pure gold is never stored from client input. `version` increments on every write and backs the EP-02-S14 stale-write check. Indexes on `status`, (`status`, `inStockAt`), tag number, HUID and `design_id` so the stock list stays fast.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None. This story only stores data.
- **Audit entry written:** No. Schema changes are tracked by the migration history (EP-02-S1); state changes are audited by EP-22-S11.
- **Data changes:** Migration on `pieces` adds or confirms `status` (check constraint), `prevStatus`, `inStockAt`, `soldAt`, `stockOutId` (nullable), `valueINR` (nullable, unused until EP-42), `version`, and the indexes above; drops `heldForLeadId` if EP-02-S5 created it. Migration creates `piece_state_transitions` (id, piece id, from status, to status, actor id, at, reason, operation name). Uses `pieces.location_id` from EP-02-S5; no transition writes it after the piece is created.
- **UI reference:** No screen.
- **Non-functional checks:** Precision: weights are integers in units of 0.0001 g, shown to 4 decimals with the EP-02-S2 helper. Time: `inStockAt`, `soldAt` and transition `at` stored in UTC. Performance: indexes sized for 5,000 pieces in stock and their history. D7 is decided: one shop, no branches; pieces carry the shop ID (EP-02-S3) and tag number and HUID are unique within the shop.
- **Depends on:** EP-02-S1, EP-02-S2, EP-02-S5, EP-02-S13, EP-02-S14, EP-21-S1, EP-15-S10
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-22-S2: System can enforce the six-state transition table

- **Story ID:** EP-22-S2
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** System can enforce the six-state transition table
- **As a:** System
- **I want:** one server module, Update Piece state, that holds the transition table, locks or version-checks the piece, refuses any change not in the table, sets the state fields, writes the transition row and publishes events after commit, and that every other epic calls instead of setting `status` itself
- **So that:** no path can skip a check when a piece moves, and in stock goes only to billed, scrapped or stopped (FR-22-1, BR-22-1, BR-22-4)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given the table, when it is inspected in the shared package, then it allows exactly: `draft` to `with_owner`, `in_stock` or `stopped`; `with_owner` to `in_stock`, `draft` or `scrapped`; `in_stock` to `billed`, `scrapped` or `stopped`; `stopped` back to its `prevStatus` only; and nothing out of `billed` or `scrapped` (proposed from the prototype transitions, to confirm with EP-23, EP-24 and EP-27).
  2. Given TAG-8841 is `in_stock`, when any caller asks to move it to `draft` or `with_owner`, then the server refuses with "TAG-8841 cannot go from In stock to Draft." (proposed wording) and nothing is stored.
  3. Given the 9 draft pieces of BATCH-2026-043 are released by EP-23, when the transition commits, then each piece is `in_stock` with `inStockAt` from the server clock, 9 transition rows exist, and "Parcel released into stock" is published once for the parcel after commit.
  4. Given a caller passes version 4 for TAG-8841 and the stored version is 5, when the transition runs, then it is refused with the EP-02-S14 conflict and the piece is unchanged.
  5. Given a code search of the server, when it is run in CI, then no module other than the transition module writes `pieces.status`.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Update Piece state is internal and callable only by server operations of other epics, never directly by a browser (System in the API table). The calling operation's role check runs first (EP-05-S2). The piece row is locked or version-checked inside the caller's transaction (EP-03-S6). `inStockAt` is set on entering `in_stock`; `soldAt` and `stockOutId` on entering `billed`; `prevStatus` on entering `stopped` and cleared on leaving it. Refusals use the EP-03-S4 code and sentence format. Events publish only after commit (EP-07-S1).
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** Emitted after commit: "Parcel released into stock" (proposed, G26) when pieces enter `in_stock`; "Piece billed by one staff member" when a piece enters `billed` (see EP-22-S6). Consumed: none.
- **Audit entry written:** Yes, through EP-22-S11: actor, time, entity (piece tag number), action (`piece_state_changed`), before (status), after (status), reason.
- **Data changes:** Inserts `piece_state_transitions` rows; updates `pieces.status`, `prevStatus`, `inStockAt`, `soldAt`, `stockOutId`, `version`. Ports the status writes in `syncParcel`, `finishRelease`, `stockOut`, `ownerScrap`, `raiseProblem` and `clearProblem` from `src/store/transitions.ts` into one service function; `routeLeadItemToStock` and `releaseHold` are not ported.
- **UI reference:** No screen. State words and colours come from `docs/ux/mockups/01-foundations.svg` (STATE WORDS v3) and the piece rail on `docs/ux/mockups/12-state-lifecycles.svg` ("Draft", "Checked", "In stock", "Billed · locked"); its "Held for a customer" segment is out of scope for v1.
- **Non-functional checks:** Concurrency: two transitions on one piece are ordered by the row lock or version; the second is refused, not merged. Security: no browser operation can set a status by name. Audit: every accepted transition is audited. Given the server holds 42 `in_stock` pieces, 5 pieces counting as With QC, 9 sold-out designs and 23 `billed` pieces, when Rajesh Verma opens `stock`, then the chips read "Can sell · 42", "With QC · 5", "Sold out · 9" and "Billed · 23", and the counts come from the server, not from the loaded page.
  2. Given "Can sell" is selected, when the list loads, then it shows only `in_stock` pieces newest first by `inStockAt`, and the card for TAG-8841 reads "Antique Kundan Choker", "TAG-8841 · 22K · Kundan", "Pure gold 41.5900 g" and "Gross · stones 48.6500 g · 7.0600 g", with no price line.

D7 is decided: one shop, so the list has no branch filter. "More filters" is not yet designed and is not part of this story.
