## EP-29-S5: System can parse a message into fields with a confidence each

- **Story ID:** EP-29-S5
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** System can parse a message into fields with a confidence each
- **As a:** System
- **I want:** a background parse job that sends the lead's message text and readable attachments to the parser, receives customer, phone, items (name, style, quantity), target weight per item and needed-by date, each with a confidence score, stores them as `lead_fields` and `lead_items`, flags every field below the decided threshold "check this", sets the lead confidence and records a ParseRun
- **So that:** staff start from fields already filled in and only need to look at the ones the parser was unsure about (FR-29-4, FR-29-5, BR-29-1, BR-29-2, BR-29-7)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given LD-2026-208 holds "namaste, for sharma wedding need 2 temple haram long chettinad type and one kundan choker. haram around 80g each, choker you suggest. need by 20 nov for engagement.", when the parse finishes, then the lead has fields Customer "Ramesh Sharma" (sure), Wants "2 × Temple Haram (Chettinad), 1 × Kundan Choker" (sure), Target weight on each haram "80.0000 g" (check this) and Needed by "20 Nov 2026" (check this) (epic acceptance criterion 1).
  2. Given that parse, when the items are stored, then `lead_items` holds "Temple Haram", style "Chettinad", quantity 2, `approxWeightG` `800000`, and "Kundan Choker", style "Kundan", quantity 1, `approxWeightG` null.
  3. Given every field is at or above the threshold, when the parse finishes, then the lead confidence is `clean` and the inbox shows "read cleanly"; given two fields below it, then confidence is `unsure` and the inbox shows "2 fields to confirm" with "Check and keep".
  4. Given the parser returns a weight of "12 to 14 g", when it is stored, then the weight field keeps that text as its value, `approxWeightG` is the midpoint `130000`, and the field is flagged "check this" whatever its score.
  5. Given the parse finishes after Rajesh Verma has already kept the lead, when the job writes, then it stores the ParseRun only and changes no field, because the lead is no longer `needs_glance`.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** The parse job is System only and runs after the lead commit (EP-10-S1). The parser key comes from environment configuration (BR-29-8). The response is validated against a fixed schema before anything is stored: unknown keys are dropped, a quantity must be a whole number of at least 1, a weight must convert to integer units through the EP-02-S2 helper, and a date must be a real calendar date; otherwise that field is stored empty and flagged. A needed-by date with no year takes the next such date on or after `arrivedAt` in Asia/Kolkata. A field is flagged when its score is below the decided threshold or its value was coerced. The job writes fields only while the lead is `needs_glance`, under the lead version check (EP-02-S14). No price or amount is extracted or stored.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** Emitted after commit: "Lead arrived / passed its SLA" carrying the new confidence, so open inboxes refetch the row (G26: no separate lead-updated event exists in the catalogue). Consumed: none.
- **Audit entry written:** No. The parse fills a lead nobody has kept yet, and the ParseRun row records provider, model version, times and outcome. The parsed values are kept as the "before" values for EP-29-S14 corrections.
- **Data changes:** Inserts `lead_fields`, `lead_items` and `parse_runs`; updates `leads.confidence`, `title`, `customerName`, `phone`, `neededBy` and `version`. Adds the parser client, the parse job and the field schema to the server. The existing `@google/genai` dependency and `GEMINI_API_KEY` slot are used only if that provider is chosen, and only on the server.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/17-lead-create.svg` left side ("WHAT THE SYSTEM PULLED OUT · FIX ANYTHING WRONG", "sure", "check this", "Target weight on each haram", "Needed by"), route `lead-review`; `docs/ux/mockups/16-lead-inbox.svg` ("2 fields to confirm", "read automatically", "read cleanly"), route `leads`.
- **Non-functional checks:** Precision: 80 g is stored as `800000` and shown as "80.0000 g"; the parser's number is never stored as a float. Performance: the parse finishes within the decided time and the lead updates live on open inboxes. Personal data: message text and images go only to the parser chosen in section 17, checked against D10 (India region, decided); logs hold lead and ParseRun ids, not content. Security: the parser key is server-side only and never in the browser bundle. Open question: where the parser is hosted and whether personal data leaves India; D10 (India region) is decided for the system's own hosting. Open questions: which parser provider and model, and the confidence thresholds.
- **Depends on:** EP-29-S1, EP-29-S2, EP-29-S3, EP-29-S4, EP-02-S2, EP-02-S14, EP-10-S1, EP-28-S13
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-29-S6: System can create a flagged lead when a message cannot be read

- **Story ID:** EP-29-S6
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** System can create a flagged lead when a message cannot be read
- **As a:** System
- **I want:** a parse that finds nothing usable, scores below the unreadable threshold, or cannot run at all to leave the lead in place with confidence `unreadable`, one flagged field "What they want" valued "Could not read", the original text or image attached, and the title "A photo we could not read · <phone>" or "A message we could not read · <sender>"
- **So that:** an unreadable order is never thrown away, staff see it flagged in red, and its 8-hour clock keeps running from arrival like any other (FR-29-6, BR-29-3, BR-29-4)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given a photo from "+91 90037 44120" that is too dark to read, when the parse returns nothing usable, then LD-2026-207 stays `needs_glance` with confidence `unreadable`, the photo attached and the field "What they want" "Could not read" flagged, and the inbox row reads "A photo we could not read · +91 90037 44120" under "Please check" with "Open and read" (epic acceptance criterion 2).
  2. Given that lead arrived at 09:00 UTC and the parse gave up at 09:03 UTC, when the SLA is read, then it is counted from 09:00 UTC, and after 8 hours the row shows "8 h limit passed · owner told" like any other lead.
  3. Given the parser provider is unavailable, when a message arrives, then the lead is still created and shown, it is marked `unreadable` after the first failed attempt, and a ParseRun with outcome `failed` and the provider error code is stored (epic acceptance criterion 6).
  4. Given a later retry under EP-29-S13 succeeds, when it finishes, then the lead's fields and confidence are replaced by the parsed result, provided the lead is still `needs_glance`.
  5. Given the sender is not a known customer, when the unreadable lead is stored, then `customerName` is "Unknown sender" and `phone` is the sender's phone, so staff can call back.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** No intake path may drop a message: lead creation does not wait on the parser and does not roll back when the parser fails. An unreadable lead can be kept only after "What they want" is filled with at least one item (EP-29-S9). The parse job cannot change a lead once a person has kept or closed it. Until the section 17 threshold is decided, a parse with no item field counts as unreadable.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** Emitted after commit: "Lead arrived / passed its SLA" carrying confidence `unreadable`, so the row turns red on open inboxes. Consumed: none.
- **Audit entry written:** No. The ParseRun row records the failure; the lead itself was created and audited by EP-29-S2 or EP-29-S3.
- **Data changes:** Inserts one `lead_fields` row and a `parse_runs` row; updates `leads.confidence`, `title` and `customerName`. Ports the "Please check" row rule from `src/components/leads/LeadInbox.tsx` onto the server confidence.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/16-lead-inbox.svg` ("Please check", "A photo we could not read · +91 90037 44120", "Open and read", "A message we cannot read still becomes a lead, flagged in red. It is never thrown away"), route `leads`.
- **Non-functional checks:** Availability: if the parser is down, leads are still created as unreadable and parsing is retried (epic section 13). Time: the SLA counts from receipt, not from the parse result. Open question: the confidence threshold that makes a lead unreadable.
- **Depends on:** EP-29-S5, EP-29-S4, EP-28-S8, EP-28-S13
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-29-S7: System can link a lead to a known customer by phone (G7)

- **Story ID:** EP-29-S7
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** System can link a lead to a known customer by phone (G7)
- **As a:** System
- **I want:** intake to run EP-17-S10 Find Customer by phone on the WhatsApp sender's phone, or on the phone the parser found in an email, and set `leads.customerId` when it matches; when nothing matches, keep the name and phone on the lead and create no customer
- **So that:** a returning customer's orders join their record without anyone searching, and the shop does not make duplicate customers from messages (FR-29-8, G7, BR-29-9)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given Ramesh Sharma (CU-004) holds "+91 98401 55504", when his WhatsApp message becomes a lead, then the lead stores `customerId` CU-004 and `customerName` "Ramesh Sharma" before parsing finishes, and the Customer field shows "Ramesh Sharma" as sure.
  2. Given "+91 90037 44120" matches no active customer, when the lead is stored, then `customerId` is null, `phone` is "+91 90037 44120", and no customer record is created.
  3. Given an email from Sri Murugan Jewellers whose body gives "+91 98401 55507", when the parse finishes, then the lead links to CU-007 and the phone field is flagged "check this", because a phone read from text is less certain than a sender phone.
  4. Given the decided G7 rule allows two active customers on one phone and both match, when the lead is stored, then `customerId` stays null and the Customer field is flagged "check this", with both names offered on `lead-review`.
  5. Given a customer was erased under EP-17-S13, when a message arrives from their old phone, then no match is made.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** The match is EP-17-S10 with the EP-17-S1 normaliser, read only, run as the System actor. A WhatsApp sender phone takes priority over a phone found in text. A match never overwrites a name a person has already confirmed. Staff can change or remove the link while keeping the lead (EP-29-S9). Erased customers are excluded.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None of its own. The link is part of the lead whose arrival or parse result is already announced.
- **Audit entry written:** No separate entry. The `lead_created` entry records `customerId` when linked at arrival; a link changed by staff is recorded by EP-29-S14.
- **Data changes:** Sets `leads.customerId` and the Customer field confidence. No new tables.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/17-lead-create.svg` left side ("Customer", "Ramesh Sharma", "sure"), route `lead-review`.
- **Non-functional checks:** Performance: the match answers in under 200 ms (EP-17-S10) and does not delay the lead's appearance. Personal data: the match reads only id and name; nothing about the customer is copied to logs. Open question G7: how a known customer is matched by phone, and what happens when several match.
- **Depends on:** EP-29-S3, EP-29-S5, EP-17-S1, EP-17-S10, EP-17-S13
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-29-S8: Staff can review the original message beside the extracted fields

- **Story ID:** EP-29-S8
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Staff can review the original message beside the extracted fields
- **As a:** Staff
- **I want:** to press "Check and keep" or "Open and read" on a `needs_glance` lead and open `lead-review` with the original message, its received time, sender and attachments on one side, and each extracted field marked "sure" or "check this" on the other
- **So that:** I can check what the system read against what the customer actually sent, in a few seconds, and never trust the parse blindly (FR-29-9, BR-29-2)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given LD-2026-208, when Rajesh Verma opens it on `lead-review`, then the left side shows "WHAT THEY SENT ON WHATSAPP" with the full text, "— Ramesh Sharma" and "received 02:14, today · +91 98401 55504", and the right side shows "WHAT THE SYSTEM PULLED OUT · FIX ANYTHING WRONG" with Customer, Wants, Target weight on each haram and Needed by.
  2. Given that lead, when the fields load, then "Target weight on each haram 80.0000 g" and "Needed by 20 Nov 2026" carry "check this", the header reads "2 fields to confirm", and Customer and Wants carry "sure".
  3. Given LD-2026-207, when it is opened, then the photo is shown from its signed link, the header reads "Please check", and the only field is "What they want" "Could not read" with "check this".
  4. Given a lead no longer `needs_glance`, when it is opened on `lead-review`, then the screen shows "This lead has already been opened. Changes here are not saved." and the keep and "Not an order" buttons are not offered.
  5. Given Vijay Kumar (Karigar) calls Read Lead for review, when it reaches the server, then it is refused with `forbidden`; given an unknown lead id, then the screen shows "That lead was not found." with "Back to leads".
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Read Lead for review is Staff and Owner only (EP-05-S2). It returns the message, received at, sender, attachment links (EP-09-S5), fields with flagged and a confidence label, items, confidence and version. Scores are mapped to "sure" and "check this" on the server so every screen agrees. Reads are limited to the caller's shop (D7).
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** Consumed: "Lead arrived / passed its SLA", so a lead kept or closed by someone else while open switches to the read-only notice, and a finished parse fills the fields. Emitted: none.
- **Audit entry written:** No. Reading a lead changes nothing.
- **Data changes:** None in the product database. Adds Read Lead for review to the shared contract. Moves `src/components/leads/LeadReview.tsx` (route `lead-review`, param `leadId`) onto the EP-08 data layer.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/17-lead-create.svg` left side ("CHECK WHAT THE SYSTEM READ", "Sharma wedding enquiry", "2 fields to confirm", "WHAT THEY SENT ON WHATSAPP", "received 02:14, today", "sure", "check this"), route `lead-review`; `docs/ux/mockups/16-lead-inbox.svg` ("Check and keep", "Open and read"), route `leads`.
- **Non-functional checks:** Performance: the review screen loads in under 2 seconds on a shop connection, with the image thumbnail first. Time: "received 02:14, today" is shown in Asia/Kolkata from the stored UTC time. Security: only staff and owner read leads (epic section 13); message text is rendered escaped. D7 is decided: reads are scoped to the one shop.
- **Depends on:** EP-29-S5, EP-29-S6, EP-29-S4, EP-28-S6, EP-05-S2, EP-09-S5, EP-08-S2, EP-08-S3, EP-08-S4, EP-08-S9, EP-08-S17
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-29-S9: Staff can fix fields and keep the lead

- **Story ID:** EP-29-S9
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Staff can fix fields and keep the lead
- **As a:** Staff
- **I want:** to change any field on `lead-review` (customer name, phone, items, target weights, needed-by date) and press "Looks right — keep the lead", so the lead moves to `opened`, every flag clears, each changed field keeps my value, and I am recorded as the person who took it
- **So that:** a parsed lead becomes a real lead after a few seconds of checking, with the corrected values used from then on (FR-29-10, FR-29-11, FR-29-13, BR-29-2, BR-29-5)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given LD-2026-208 in `needs_glance`, when Rajesh Verma changes "Needed by" from 20 Nov 2026 to 18 Nov 2026 and presses "Looks right — keep the lead", then the lead is `opened` with confidence `clean`, every field `flagged` false, `neededBy` 18 Nov 2026 and `takenBy` Rajesh, and the needed-by field holds `correctedValue` "18 Nov 2026" and `correctedBy` Rajesh (epic acceptance criterion 3).
  2. Given a lead already `opened`, when keep is called, then the server refuses with "This lead has already been opened." and nothing changes.
  3. Given the customer name is cleared, no item line is left, or the date is not a real date, when keep is pressed, then the server refuses with "Add the customer name.", "Add at least one item the customer wants." or "The needed-by date is not a valid date." and the lead stays `needs_glance`.
  4. Given LD-2026-208 is still `needs_glance`, when Deepak Rao tries to route a line to a piece or to make (EP-30), then the server refuses with "Check and keep this lead before converting it." (epic acceptance criterion 4).
  5. Given Rajesh and Deepak press keep on the same lead at the same moment, when both reach the server, then one keep succeeds and the other gets "This lead has already been opened.", and the SLA timer keeps running because `opened` still counts.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Confirm lead is Staff and Owner only (EP-05-S2). It is allowed only from `needs_glance`, under the lead row lock and version check (EP-02-S14); otherwise the prototype sentence is returned. The patch accepts customer name, phone, customer id, needed by and items; weights are converted to integer units with at most 4 decimals (EP-02-S2). A changed customer id must exist and not be erased. All flags clear and confidence becomes `clean`. A shared guard refuses any conversion while the lead is `needs_glance` with "Check and keep this lead before converting it."; EP-30 calls it. The SLA keeps running in `opened` (EP-28-S8). Update and audit run in one transaction (EP-03-S6).
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** Emitted after commit: "Lead arrived / passed its SLA" carrying state `opened`, so the row leaves the Needs a glance group on every open inbox. Consumed: none.
- **Audit entry written:** Yes, through EP-29-S14: actor, time, entity (lead id), action `lead_confirmed`, before (state `needs_glance` and each changed field's parsed value), after (state `opened` and each corrected value), taken by.
- **Data changes:** Updates `leads.state`, `confidence`, `customerName`, `phone`, `customerId`, `neededBy`, `takenBy`, `takenAt` and `version`; updates `lead_fields.flagged`, `correctedValue` and `correctedBy`; replaces `lead_items` when items change. Adds Confirm lead to the shared contract. Ports `confirmLead` and the `routeLeadItemToStock` guard from `src/store/transitions.ts`.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/17-lead-create.svg` left side ("WHAT THE SYSTEM PULLED OUT · FIX ANYTHING WRONG", "Looks right — keep the lead"), route `lead-review`.
- **Non-functional checks:** Concurrency: two staff keeping the same lead give one keep and one refusal, never two audit entries. Precision: a corrected weight of 78.5 g is stored as `785000`. Audit: corrections are appended with before and after values (epic section 13). Time: `takenAt` from the server clock in UTC.
- **Depends on:** EP-29-S8, EP-29-S7, EP-28-S8, EP-05-S2, EP-02-S2, EP-02-S14, EP-03-S4, EP-03-S6, EP-08-S5, EP-08-S7
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-29-S10: Staff can close a lead as "Not an order"

- **Story ID:** EP-29-S10
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Staff can close a lead as "Not an order"
- **As a:** Staff
- **I want:** to press "Not an order" on `lead-review` for a message that is a greeting, spam or a question with nothing to make or sell, so the lead becomes `lost` with reason "Not an order" and leaves the open tabs of the inbox
- **So that:** the inbox holds only real orders, while the message itself is kept and traceable (FR-29-12, FR-29-17)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given a `needs_glance` lead whose message is "good morning sir", when Deepak Rao presses "Not an order", then the lead is `lost` with `lostReason` "Not an order", its SLA timer is cancelled in the same transaction, and he is returned to `leads`.
  2. Given that lead, when the "Needs a glance" tab reloads, then its count goes down by 1 and the lead appears only under "All".
  3. Given a lead already `converted`, when "Not an order" is called, then the server refuses with "A converted lead cannot be marked lost." and nothing changes.
  4. Given a lead already `lost`, when "Not an order" is called again, then it is returned unchanged and no second audit entry is written.
  5. Given the lead is closed, when Sanjay Seth reads it later, then the original message, attachments and InboundMessage are still there.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Not an order is Staff and Owner only (EP-05-S2). It calls the EP-28-S11 Mark lost service with the fixed reason "Not an order", so the converted refusal, timer cancel and version check are the same. It is offered from `needs_glance` on `lead-review`; the service also allows `opened` and `being_worked`. No piece is read or written, because v1 has no holds. The message and attachments are not deleted; their retention follows the open retention rule.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** Emitted after commit: "Lead arrived / passed its SLA" carrying state `lost`, through EP-28-S13. Consumed: none.
- **Audit entry written:** Yes, through EP-29-S14: actor, time, entity (lead id), action `lead_not_an_order`, before (state), after `lost`, reason "Not an order".
- **Data changes:** Updates `leads.state`, `lostReason` and `version`; cancels the pending SLA job row. Adds Not an order to the shared contract.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/17-lead-create.svg` left side ("Not an order"), route `lead-review`.
- **Non-functional checks:** Concurrency: "Not an order" racing a keep on the same lead is settled by the version check; one wins and the other sees the current state. Audit: the closure is appended with its reason. Personal data: closing a lead does not erase its message; erasure is EP-17-S13.
- **Depends on:** EP-29-S8, EP-28-S11, EP-10-S6, EP-05-S2, EP-02-S14, EP-08-S5
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-29-S11: System can turn a broadcast reply into a lead

- **Story ID:** EP-29-S11
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** System can turn a broadcast reply into a lead
- **As a:** System
- **I want:** an inbound WhatsApp message whose replied-to outbound message id belongs to a broadcast to become a lead in `needs_glance` with source `whatsapp`, `broadcastId` set, `customerId` set to the recipient and title "<customer name> · replied to the broadcast", and then go through the normal parse
- **So that:** a customer answering a broadcast or a shared catalogue is never lost, and the owner can see which broadcast brought which leads (FR-29-15, BR-29-6)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given Priya Malhotra (CU-002) received a broadcast to the "VIP Bridal" group, when she replies "I like the second necklace, can I see it on Saturday?", then a lead is stored with state `needs_glance`, `broadcastId` of that broadcast, `customerId` CU-002, title "Priya Malhotra · replied to the broadcast" and the reply as `message`.
  2. Given that lead, when the parse finds no confident item, then the field "What they want" holds the reply text flagged "check this" and confidence is `unsure`, as in the prototype `simulateReply`.
  3. Given the provider sends no replied-to id, when the message arrives, then the lead is created as an ordinary WhatsApp lead with `broadcastId` null, and no broadcast is guessed.
  4. Given the reply is an opt-out keyword such as "STOP", when it is handled, then EP-12-S10 switches consent off and no lead is created.
  5. Given the lead is created, when Rajesh Verma has `leads` open, then the row shows "from WhatsApp" within about 1 second and its SLA counts from the reply's received time.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Only the System actor creates a reply lead, through the EP-29-S3 intake interface. The broadcast is found only from the replied-to OutboundMessage id the provider supplies (EP-12-S7); a broadcast id sent from any client is ignored. The customer is the broadcast recipient tied to that outbound message, and the sender phone must match that recipient, else `customerId` is left to EP-29-S7. Duplicate rules (EP-29-S12) apply as for any message. The prototype `simulateReply` in `src/components/marketing/Broadcast.tsx` is a demo tool and is removed from production builds (EP-08-S19).
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** Emitted after commit: "Lead arrived / passed its SLA" (arrived), through EP-28-S13. Consumed: none; the reply comes through the EP-12 webhook.
- **Audit entry written:** Yes, through EP-29-S14: actor System (WhatsApp intake), time, entity (lead id), action `lead_created`, after (source `whatsapp`, state `needs_glance`, broadcast id, customer id).
- **Data changes:** Inserts into `leads` with `broadcastId` and the pending SLA job row; updates `inbound_messages.leadId`. Ports `simulateReply` from `src/store/transitions.ts` into the intake path without the demo trigger.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/27-broadcast.svg` ("replies become leads", "A reply lands in the lead inbox (16)"), route `broadcast`; `docs/ux/mockups/28-catalogue-share.svg` ("Replies land in the lead inbox as new leads"), route `catalogue`; `docs/ux/mockups/16-lead-inbox.svg`, route `leads`.
- **Non-functional checks:** Performance: the reply lead appears in the inbox within about 1 second of the webhook being accepted. Personal data: the reply text is personal data and follows the lead's retention. Open decision D8: whether the chosen provider supplies a replied-to id. Open question G17: whether reply counts per broadcast are kept here or in EP-34.
- **Depends on:** EP-29-S3, EP-29-S5, EP-29-S7, EP-12-S7, EP-12-S10, EP-02-S12, EP-08-S19, EP-28-S13
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-29-S12: System can detect a duplicate message and link it to the first lead

- **Story ID:** EP-29-S12
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** System can detect a duplicate message and link it to the first lead
- **As a:** System
- **I want:** intake to check each new InboundMessage, before a lead is created, against messages from the same sender with the same normalised content (text plus attachment hashes) inside the decided window, or with the same provider message id or email Message-ID, and when one matches, set `duplicateOf` to the first message and link it to the first lead instead of creating another
- **So that:** a forwarded or resent order does not flood the inbox with copies, and no copy is thrown away either (FR-29-14)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given the email from Sri Murugan Jewellers arrives twice with the same Message-ID, when the second copy is processed, then no second lead is created, the second InboundMessage has `duplicateOf` set to the first, and its `leadId` is LD-2026-209 (epic acceptance criterion 5).
  2. Given Ramesh Sharma sends the same text twice from "+91 98401 55504" 3 minutes apart and the window is 30 minutes, when the second arrives, then it is linked to the first lead and no new lead or SLA timer is created.
  3. Given the same text arrives from a different sender, or from the same sender outside the window, when it is processed, then a new lead is created.
  4. Given a duplicate is linked, when Rajesh Verma opens the first lead on `lead-review`, then it shows "Sent 2 times · last at <time>" (proposed wording) and the first arrival time stays the SLA start.
  5. Given two copies are processed by two workers at the same moment, when both commit, then exactly one lead exists, because the check and the lead insert run under a lock on sender and content hash.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** The duplicate check runs inside the intake transaction (EP-03-S6), under an advisory lock or unique key on (channel, sender, content hash, window bucket). A match by provider message id is always a duplicate; a match by content is a duplicate only inside the window. The window is a setting with a default of 30 minutes until the section 17 thread question decides it. A duplicate never changes the first lead's `arrivedAt`, state or fields. If the first lead is `lost` or `converted`, a later copy inside the window is still linked, not made into a new lead.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None for a linked duplicate, since no lead is created and no state changes. Consumed: none.
- **Audit entry written:** No. The InboundMessage row with `duplicateOf` records the link; no lead state changes.
- **Data changes:** Adds `contentHash` and an index on (channel, sender, contentHash, receivedAt) to `inbound_messages`; sets `duplicateOf` and `leadId` on copies. Adds a `duplicateWindowMinutes` setting.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/16-lead-inbox.svg`, route `leads` (one row per order). The "Sent 2 times" note on `lead-review` is not yet designed.
- **Non-functional checks:** Concurrency: two copies at once give one lead. Personal data: the content hash is one-way and holds no text; the hash index is dropped with the message on erasure. Time: the window is measured on `receivedAt` in UTC. Open questions: how several messages in one thread are treated, and the length of the window.
- **Depends on:** EP-29-S1, EP-29-S2, EP-29-S3, EP-29-S4, EP-03-S6, EP-03-S8, EP-13-S1
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-29-S13: System can retry a failed parse and report failures

- **Story ID:** EP-29-S13
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** System can retry a failed parse and report failures
- **As a:** System
- **I want:** a failed parse retried with backoff by the EP-10 job runner, each attempt recorded as a ParseRun, the last failure left as `failed` with its error code, and an owner-only Parse status read that lists recent failures and retries
- **So that:** a short parser outage fixes itself, a lasting one is seen by the owner, and no message content ends up in logs (FR-29-16, BR-29-7)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given the parser returns a timeout for LD-2026-207, when the job runs, then it is retried after the EP-10-S3 backoff, each attempt is a ParseRun with outcome `failed`, attempt number and error code, and the lead stays visible as `unreadable` throughout.
  2. Given the third attempt succeeds, when it finishes, then the lead's fields and confidence come from that run and the earlier ParseRuns remain.
  3. Given all attempts fail, when the last one ends, then the job is marked failed, the lead stays `unreadable`, and the failure appears in the Parse status read with lead id, provider, error code and time.
  4. Given Sanjay Seth opens Parse status, when it loads, then it lists the last 7 days of failed and retried parses, newest first; given Rajesh Verma calls it, then it is refused with `forbidden`.
  5. Given any failure is logged, when the log line is inspected, then it holds the lead id, ParseRun id, provider and error code, and no message text, phone number or image.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Retries use the EP-10-S3 backoff with a capped number of attempts, so parse cost cannot grow without limit (epic section 16). A retry is skipped once the lead has left `needs_glance`. Parse status is Owner only (EP-05-S2). Errors are logged by id and code only; full monitoring and alerts are EP-37, which reads the same ParseRun rows.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** Emitted after commit of a successful retry: "Lead arrived / passed its SLA" carrying the new confidence. Consumed: none.
- **Audit entry written:** No. ParseRun rows and the EP-10-S2 run history record attempts; no user-visible state is changed by a person.
- **Data changes:** Inserts `parse_runs` per attempt; updates `leads.confidence` and fields on success. Adds the owner-only Parse status read to the shared contract.
- **UI reference:** Not yet designed. Parse status can be shown beside recent job runs (EP-10-S13); no mockup draws it.
- **Non-functional checks:** Availability: if the parser is down, leads are still created as unreadable and parsing is retried (epic section 13). Personal data: logs hold ids, not content (FR-29-16). Performance: the retry cap and per-lead attempt count let EP-37 measure parse cost per lead.
- **Depends on:** EP-29-S5, EP-29-S6, EP-10-S2, EP-10-S3, EP-10-S13, EP-05-S2
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-29-S14: System can audit confirm, corrections and "Not an order"

- **Story ID:** EP-29-S14
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** System can audit confirm, corrections and "Not an order"
- **As a:** System
- **I want:** an append-only audit entry written in the same transaction as each intake lead create (`lead_created`), each keep (`lead_confirmed`) with every corrected field's parsed and new value, and each "Not an order" (`lead_not_an_order`), with actor, role, time, lead id, before, after and reason
- **So that:** the owner can see which leads the system made, who checked each one, what they changed from the parse, and why a message was set aside (FR-29-17)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given Rajesh Verma keeps LD-2026-208 after changing the needed-by date, when it commits, then a `lead_confirmed` entry holds actor Rajesh, role Staff, time, LD-2026-208, before state `needs_glance` and needed by 20 Nov 2026, after state `opened` and needed by 18 Nov 2026 (epic acceptance criterion 3).
  2. Given he also changes the haram target weight from 80 g to 78.5 g, when it commits, then the same entry records before `800000` and after `785000` as integer units.
  3. Given Deepak Rao presses "Not an order", when it commits, then a `lead_not_an_order` entry holds before state, after `lost` and reason "Not an order".

Before and after values follow EP-06-S3; weights are integer units (EP-06-S5). Intake entries use the System actor for the channel (EP-06-S6). `lead_confirmed` and `lead_not_an_order` are added to the audit kind list in the "Leads" group from EP-28-S14. Entries hold the customer id and changed field keys, not the message text; a corrected name or phone is recorded as "changed" without the value, so erasure (EP-17-S13) leaves no personal data in the log.

- **Data changes:** Inserts into `audit_entries`. Adds `lead_confirmed` and `lead_not_an_order` to the audit kind list in the shared package; the migration widens the kind check constraint if it is a database enum.
- **UI reference:** The security log screen from EP-06-S9 to EP-06-S11. No new screen.
- **Non-functional checks:** Audit: confirm, field corrections and "Not an order" are appended with before and after values (epic section 13). Personal data: no message text, name or phone values in entries. Precision: weights in entries are integer units of 0.0001 g. Time: entry times in UTC, shown in Asia/Kolkata.
- **Depends on:** EP-29-S2, EP-29-S3, EP-29-S9, EP-29-S10, EP-28-S14, EP-06-S1, EP-06-S2, EP-06-S3, EP-06-S5, EP-06-S6, EP-06-S10, EP-06-S12

# EP-30: Lead conversion · stories

Epic document: [EP-30 Lead conversion](../epics/EP-30-lead-conversion.md)

Role note: stories where the server stores, derives, refreshes or audits on its own use "System". Staff and the owner convert leads; karigars never see leads and every operation here refuses them (epic section 13). v1 has no holds: linking a line to a piece records the piece id for reference only, the piece stays `in_stock` and anyone can still sell it (BR-30-3). The mockup 18 button "Hold TAG-8841 for them", the "Hold it and go to sell" card and the line "It leaves the showcase and other quotes cannot see it" are out of scope; these stories replace them with a link action. No amount is read or shown. Weights are integers in units of 0.0001 g and shown to 4 decimals, so the mockup's "41.590 g" is shown as "41.5900 g". The seed people are Sanjay Seth (Owner), Rajesh Verma and Deepak Rao (Staff) and Lakshmi Devi · KG-01 (Karigar). The worked example is the Sharma wedding lead LD-2026-208 from Ramesh Sharma (CU-004), after it has been kept under EP-29-S9, with two lines: "Temple Haram · Chettinad · ×2", around 80.0000 g each, and "Kundan Choker · ×1" with no weight given. TAG-8841 is the Antique Kundan Choker, 22K, gross 48.6500 g, pure gold 41.5900 g.

## EP-30-S1: System can store a route per lead line

- **Story ID:** EP-30-S1
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** System can store a route per lead line
- **As a:** System
- **I want:** `lead_items` to carry a route kind (`stock`, `make` or null), a piece id for a stock route, a job id for a make route, routed at and routed by, with database checks that keep these columns consistent
- **So that:** every line of a lead records how it will be met, and the piece id on a stock line is a reference that never touches the piece (FR-30-2, FR-30-6, BR-30-1, BR-30-3, BR-30-7)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given the migration has run, when `lead_items` is inspected, then it has `routeKind` (nullable, accepting only `stock` and `make`), `routePieceId` (nullable, foreign key to `pieces`), `routeJobId` (nullable, foreign key to `karigar_jobs`), `routedAt` (UTC, nullable) and `routedBy` (nullable, foreign key to `users`).
  2. Given a line with `routeKind` `stock` and no `routePieceId`, or `routeKind` `make` and no `routeJobId`, or `routeKind` null with a piece id set, when it is written, then the database rejects it through a check constraint.
  3. Given the Kundan Choker line of LD-2026-208 is stored with `routeKind` `stock` and `routePieceId` TAG-8841, when `pieces` is read, then TAG-8841 has no column that points back to the lead, its `status` is still `in_stock` and its version is unchanged (BR-30-3).
  4. Given the prototype seed is loaded into staging (EP-02-S13), when the migration runs, then each seeded `LeadItem.route` of `{ kind: 'stock', pieceId }` or `{ kind: 'make', jobId }` is copied into the new columns, and no `heldForLeadId` value is carried over.
  5. Given a line approximate weight of 80 g, when it is read back, then `approxWeightG` is the integer `800000`, and the route columns do not change it.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Check constraints on route kind and the matching id column. `routePieceId` references `pieces`, `routeJobId` references `karigar_jobs`, `routedBy` references `users`. A job id may route at most one lead line (unique partial index on `routeJobId`). Every update of a line goes through the parent lead's version check (EP-02-S14). No column on `pieces` refers to a lead.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None. Storing the columns publishes nothing.
- **Audit entry written:** No. Table rules only; each route change is audited by EP-30-S9.

## EP-30-S2: System can derive the lead state from its routed lines

- **Story ID:** EP-30-S2
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** System can derive the lead state from its routed lines
- **As a:** System
- **I want:** one server function, called inside every route, unroute and make transaction, that sets the lead state from its lines: `opened` to `being_worked` on the first routed line, `being_worked` to `converted` when at least one line exists and every line is routed, and `converted` back to `being_worked` when a line is unrouted
- **So that:** the lead state and its routes can never drift apart, and "converted" always means every item has a way to be met (FR-30-7, FR-30-8, BR-30-2)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given LD-2026-208 is `opened` with both lines unrouted, when the Kundan Choker line is routed, then in the same transaction the lead becomes `being_worked`, `takenBy` is set to the caller if it was empty, `takenAt` is the server time, and the pending SLA timer is cancelled (EP-10-S6).
  2. Given LD-2026-208 is `being_worked` with the choker routed, when the Temple Haram line is routed to make, then the lead becomes `converted` in the same transaction (epic acceptance criterion 3).
  3. Given LD-2026-208 is `converted`, when the choker line is unrouted, then the lead becomes `being_worked` in the same transaction (epic acceptance criterion 4).
  4. Given a lead with no lines, when the function runs, then the state does not become `converted`, matching `isFullyRouted` in `src/domain/leads.ts`.
  5. Given the line update succeeds but the lead version has changed since it was read, when the transaction commits, then the whole operation is rolled back with the EP-02-S14 conflict and neither the line nor the lead changes.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** The function is internal and never called from a browser. It runs under the lead row lock taken by the calling operation (EP-03-S6). A `lost` or `needs_glance` lead is never changed by it; the callers refuse first. Its only outputs are `being_worked` and `converted`. The SLA timer is cancelled only on the move out of `opened`. Ports `settleLeadState` from `src/store/transitions.ts` and `isFullyRouted` from `src/domain/leads.ts` into the shared package.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** Emitted after commit, only when the state changes: "Lead arrived / passed its SLA" carrying the new state, through EP-28-S13, as for every other lead state change, so open inboxes move the row. EP-30 adds no event of its own (README gap G26 lists none for routing). Consumed: none.
- **Audit entry written:** Yes, as part of the line entry written by EP-30-S9: lead state before and after are recorded on the `line_linked_stock`, `line_routed_make` or `line_unlinked` entry. No separate lead entry.
- **Data changes:** Updates `leads.state`, `takenBy`, `takenAt` and `version`; cancels the pending SLA job row (EP-10-S6). No new tables.
- **UI reference:** No screen. The result is shown on `docs/ux/mockups/18-convert-lead.svg`, route `lead-convert`, by EP-30-S6, and on `docs/ux/mockups/12-state-lifecycles.svg` (lead fork, without its "Held for a customer" segment).
- **Non-functional checks:** Concurrency: the route and the lead state change share one transaction; two staff routing the last two lines at once both commit under the lock in turn and the lead ends `converted` once, never stuck in `being_worked` (epic section 13). Time: `takenAt` from the server clock in UTC. Open question: whether a line whose linked piece was sold still counts as routed; this function counts any line with a route kind, and changes only if that question is answered otherwise.
- **Depends on:** EP-30-S1, EP-28-S1, EP-28-S10, EP-28-S13, EP-10-S6, EP-02-S14, EP-03-S6
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-30-S3: Staff can see matching in-stock pieces for a line

- **Story ID:** EP-30-S3
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Staff can see matching in-stock pieces for a line
- **As a:** Staff
- **I want:** to open `lead-convert` for a lead and see, under each unrouted line, the in-stock pieces whose kind matches the line and whose pure gold or gross lies within 20% of the line's approximate weight when one is given
- **So that:** I can tell at a glance which items are already in the showcase and which are best made fresh (FR-30-1, FR-30-11, BR-30-1, BR-30-7)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given LD-2026-208 is `opened` and TAG-8841 (Antique Kundan Choker) is `in_stock`, when Rajesh Verma opens `lead-convert` with `leadId` LD-2026-208, then the heading reads "Sharma wedding · what happens to this lead?", the subtitle reads "Ramesh Sharma · 2 Temple Harams and 1 Kundan Choker · needed by 20 Nov", and the choker line reads "TAG-8841 matches what they described · 41.5900 g, in the showcase" with "already here — no need to make it".
  2. Given no in-stock piece has a kind that matches "Temple Haram", when the screen loads, then that line reads "around 80.0000 g each · nothing like it in stock right now" with "best made fresh", and "Make it — order to karigar" is the primary action.
  3. Given a line "Polki Choker" at 45.5000 g (`455000` units) and in-stock Polki chokers with pure gold 36.4000 g, 54.6000 g and 54.6001 g, when the matches are computed, then the first two are listed and the third is not, because the test is 5 × |weight − 455000| ≤ 455000 on integers, against either pure gold or gross.
  4. Given a piece is `billed`, `scrapped`, `stopped`, `draft` or `with_owner`, when matches are computed, then it is not listed; a piece already linked to another lead's line is still listed, because no line reserves a piece (FR-30-3).
  5. Given Vijay Kumar (Karigar) calls the matching pieces read for any line, when it reaches the server, then it is refused through EP-05-S2 and returns no piece or lead data.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** List matching pieces is Staff and Owner only (EP-05-S2). Suggestions are computed on the server from `pieces.status = in_stock`, using the prototype `stockMatches` kind rule (case-insensitive containment either way, or every word of the line name found in the piece kind) and the 20% window in integer units. A line with no approximate weight matches on kind alone. Matches are ordered by closeness to the approximate weight, then by tag. The read returns tag, kind, purity, gross and pure gold in integer units; no value or price field. Read lead routing returns lines, routes, the routed count and the lead state.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** Consumed: "Piece billed by one staff member" and "Piece scrapped" (proposed, G26) to drop a gone piece from the suggestions; "Parcel released into stock" (proposed, G26) to refetch, so newly released pieces can appear. Emitted: none.
- **Audit entry written:** No. Reads are not audited.
- **Data changes:** None in the product database. Adds List matching pieces and Read lead routing to the shared contract. Moves `src/components/leads/ConvertLead.tsx` off `useStore()` onto the EP-08 data layer and ports `stockMatches` to the server.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/18-convert-lead.svg` ("TWO WAYS TO MEET IT · PER ITEM, SO A LEAD CAN SPLIT BOTH WAYS", "around 80 g each · nothing like it in stock right now", "best made fresh", "TAG-8841 matches what they described · 41.590 g, in the showcase", "already here — no need to make it"), route `lead-convert`. Weights show to 4 decimals in v1.
- **Non-functional checks:** Performance: `lead-convert` with its suggestions loads under 2 seconds (epic section 13). Precision: the 20% window is computed on integers in units of 0.0001 g, never on floats. Security: Staff and Owner only; karigars never see leads. Availability: loading, error, offline and reconnecting states (EP-08-S3, EP-08-S4, EP-08-S10, EP-08-S11). Open question A4: whether a piece with an open edit proposal is listed and can be linked.
- **Depends on:** EP-30-S1, EP-22-S1, EP-22-S3, EP-22-S7, EP-28-S6, EP-05-S2, EP-08-S1, EP-08-S3, EP-08-S4, EP-08-S9, EP-08-S10, EP-08-S11, EP-08-S13, EP-08-S17
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-30-S4: Staff can link a line to an in-stock piece without reserving it

- **Story ID:** EP-30-S4
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Staff can link a line to an in-stock piece without reserving it
- **As a:** Staff
- **I want:** to pick one of the suggested pieces for an unrouted line and press "Link TAG-8841 to this line" (proposed wording, replacing "Hold TAG-8841 for them"), so the line is routed to stock with that piece id while the piece stays in the showcase
- **So that:** the lead records that this item will come from stock, and no sale anywhere in the shop is blocked by it (FR-30-2, FR-30-3, FR-30-4, FR-30-5, BR-30-3, BR-30-4)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given LD-2026-208 is `opened` and TAG-8841 is `in_stock`, when Rajesh Verma links TAG-8841 to the Kundan Choker line, then the line has `routeKind` `stock`, `routePieceId` TAG-8841 and `routedBy` Rajesh, the lead is `being_worked`, and TAG-8841 is still `in_stock` with an unchanged version on every staff screen (epic acceptance criterion 1).
  2. Given LD-2026-208 is still `needs_glance`, when Deepak Rao tries to link a piece, then the server refuses with "Check and keep this lead before converting it." and nothing changes (epic acceptance criterion 5).
  3. Given Rajesh has already linked the choker line, when Deepak links another piece to the same line from a screen loaded earlier, then the server refuses with "That line has already been routed." and the first link stays (epic acceptance criterion 6).
  4. Given the chosen piece was billed after the screen loaded, when Rajesh presses the link button, then the server refuses with "TAG-8841 is not in stock." and the line stays unrouted.
  5. Given the line has quantity 2, when a link is attempted, then the server refuses with "A link covers one piece. This line asks for 2, so make it." (adapted from the prototype) until the open question on splitting quantity is decided; and after a successful link the line shows "Not reserved. Anyone can still sell TAG-8841." (proposed wording).
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Route line to stock is Staff and Owner only (EP-05-S2). It refuses a `needs_glance` lead with the shared guard from EP-29-S9, a `lost` lead with "This lead is closed." (proposed), a routed line with "That line has already been routed.", and a piece not `in_stock` with "{id} is not in stock.". The piece row is read, not locked or written; there is no "already held" refusal and no `heldForLeadId`. The line update, the lead state from EP-30-S2 and the audit entry run in one transaction under the lead row lock (EP-03-S6). The line must belong to the lead in the request. Deduplicated by idempotency key (EP-03-S8).
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** Emitted after commit through EP-30-S2 when the lead state changes: "Lead arrived / passed its SLA" carrying `being_worked`. No piece event, because the piece does not change. Consumed: "Piece billed by one staff member" to disable the link button for a piece that has just been sold.
- **Audit entry written:** Yes, through EP-30-S9: actor, time, entity (lead id and line id), action `line_linked_stock`, after (piece id), lead state before and after.
- **Data changes:** Updates `lead_items` route columns and `leads.state`, `version`. Adds Route line to stock to the shared contract. Ports `routeLeadItemToStock` from `src/store/transitions.ts` without the hold part.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/18-convert-lead.svg` ("Kundan Choker · ×1", "Sell from stock"), route `lead-convert`. The mockup's "Hold TAG-8841 for them" and "Hold it and go to sell" are replaced by the link action and the not-reserved line; the replacement is not yet designed.
- **Non-functional checks:** Concurrency: two staff linking the same line at once, one succeeds and the other sees "That line has already been routed." (epic section 13); a link racing a sale of the same piece never blocks the sale. Security: Staff and Owner only. Audit: the link is appended with actor and time. Open questions: whether a quantity 2 line can be split one from stock and one made, and whether one line can link several pieces; A4, whether a piece with an open edit proposal can be linked.
- **Depends on:** EP-30-S1, EP-30-S2, EP-30-S3, EP-29-S9, EP-22-S1, EP-05-S2, EP-03-S4, EP-03-S6, EP-03-S8, EP-08-S5, EP-08-S6, EP-08-S7
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-30-S5: Staff can send a line to make through an order copy

- **Story ID:** EP-30-S5
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Staff can send a line to make through an order copy
- **As a:** Staff
- **I want:** to press "Make it — order to karigar" on an unrouted line, land on `order-copy` with `leadId` and `itemId`, see the line's quantity, target weight and the lead's reference images filled in, and when I press "Send the order copy" have the line routed to make with the new job in the same transaction
- **So that:** a made item becomes a karigar job with the lead attached, and the customer's request is tracked until the piece is ready (FR-30-6, BR-30-1, BR-30-5)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given LD-2026-208 is `being_worked` with the choker linked, when Rajesh Verma presses "Make it — order to karigar" on the Temple Haram line, then `order-copy` opens with the line "From the Sharma lead · 2 × Temple Haram, Chettinad · this becomes a job on the karigar's phone", "How many" 2, "Finished piece should weigh" "80.0000 g" and the lead's photos attached.
  2. Given Rajesh picks Lakshmi Devi · KG-01 and due date 17 Nov 2026 and presses "Send the order copy", when EP-19-S2 commits, then in the same transaction the order copy stores `leadId` LD-2026-208 and `leadItemId` of the haram line, the line has `routeKind` `make` and `routeJobId` the new MO- job, and the lead becomes `converted` (epic acceptance criterion 3).
  3. Given the send succeeds, when the screen returns to `lead-convert` with `sent` set to the job id, then it shows "Order copy sent. MO-2026-NNN is on Lakshmi Devi's phone, waiting to be accepted." and the line shows "Order copy sent as MO-2026-NNN to Lakshmi Devi".
  4. Given Deepak Rao routed the same line while Rajesh was filling the form, when Rajesh sends, then the server refuses with "That line has already been routed.", and no order copy, job or metal pool entry is created.
  5. Given the lead is `needs_glance`, when "Make it — order to karigar" is shown, then it is disabled, and a direct send with that `leadId` is refused with "Check and keep this lead before converting it."
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Route line to make runs only inside the EP-19-S2 create transaction, never on its own from a browser. The lead and line checks (not `needs_glance`, not `lost`, line belongs to lead, line not routed) run under the lead row lock before the pool lock; the lock order is lead, then pool, then karigar (extends EP-18-S5). If any check fails the whole create rolls back, so no gold is issued. The job payload sent to the karigar carries no lead id, customer name or phone (EP-19-S5). Prefilled values are suggestions; the server stores what is sent.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** Emitted after commit through EP-19-S2: "Karigar job status changed" and "Metal pool changed"; through EP-30-S2 when the state changes: "Lead arrived / passed its SLA". Consumed: "Metal pool changed" on `order-copy`, so the gold available is current when the line is sent (epic section 11).
- **Audit entry written:** Yes: `order_copy_sent` through EP-19-S2 with the lead id, and `line_routed_make` through EP-30-S9 with actor, time, lead id, line id, job id and lead state before and after.
- **Data changes:** Updates `lead_items` route columns and `leads.state`, `version` inside the EP-19-S2 transaction; `order_copies.leadId` and `leadItemId` are set. Adds the lead and line fields to Create Order copy and job in the shared contract. Ports the lead branch of `createOrderCopyAndJob` from `src/store/transitions.ts`.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/18-convert-lead.svg` ("Make it — order to karigar", "Build the order copy"), route `lead-convert`; `docs/ux/mockups/19-order-copy-builder.svg` ("From the Sharma lead · 2 × Temple Haram, Chettinad", "Finished piece should weigh", "Send the order copy"), route `order-copy`. Weights show to 4 decimals in v1.
- **Non-functional checks:** Concurrency: routing the line and creating the job share one transaction; a line can be sent to make once only. Precision: the prefilled 80 g is `800000` units and shown as "80.0000 g". Security: the karigar never receives the customer or the lead. Open decision D8 and open question: whether the customer is told when the made piece is ready, by whom and through which channel; nothing is sent to the customer in this story.
- **Depends on:** EP-30-S1, EP-30-S2, EP-30-S3, EP-19-S2, EP-19-S3, EP-19-S4, EP-19-S5, EP-18-S5, EP-18-S10, EP-29-S9, EP-08-S5, EP-08-S6
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

- **Non-functional checks:** Performance: the state change shows on other staff screens within about 1 second. Availability: a dropped connection shows "Reconnecting…" and the state catches up on return (EP-08-S10). Audit: none here.

## EP-30-S8: Staff can see when a linked piece is sold to someone else

- **Story ID:** EP-30-S8
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Staff can see when a linked piece is sold to someone else
- **As a:** Staff
- **I want:** a line linked to a piece that is billed or scrapped to show the piece as gone within about a second, with other matches and "Make it — order to karigar" offered beside it
- **So that:** I learn at once that the piece I meant for this customer has left, and I can pick another or have it made before I promise anything (FR-30-9, BR-30-3, BR-30-6)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given TAG-8841 is linked to the Sharma choker line and Rajesh Verma has `lead-convert` open, when Deepak Rao sells TAG-8841 to a walk-in customer, then the sale succeeds through EP-26, and within about 1 second Rajesh's line reads "TAG-8841 has been sold. Pick another piece or make it." (proposed wording) with no reload (epic acceptance criterion 2).
  2. Given that line, when it is shown, then "Unlink" and the other in-stock matches for "Kundan Choker" are offered, and pressing "Make it — order to karigar" is allowed only after the line is unlinked.
  3. Given the owner scraps a linked piece, when "Piece scrapped" (proposed, G26) arrives, then the line reads "<tag> has been scrapped. Pick another piece or make it." (proposed wording).
  4. Given Rajesh opens `lead-convert` later or after reconnecting, when the lines load, then a line whose piece is `billed` or `scrapped` shows as gone from the server read, not only from a missed event (EP-07-S7).
  5. Given the linked piece goes `stopped` under EP-24, when the line loads, then it reads "<tag> is stopped and cannot be sold right now." (proposed wording) and is not marked gone.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Read lead routing returns, for each stock line, the linked piece's current status, so the gone mark is derived on the server. A linked line never stops a sale: EP-26 neither reads nor writes lead lines, and the double-sell rule stays in EP-22-S6 and EP-26-S3 (BR-30-6). Until the open question is decided, a line whose piece is gone keeps its route and still counts toward converted.

- **Data changes:** None in the product database. Adds the linked piece status to the Read lead routing response.
- **UI reference:** Not yet designed. The gone state of a linked line is not drawn on `docs/ux/mockups/18-convert-lead.svg`; it sits on route `lead-convert`.
- **Non-functional checks:** Performance: a sold linked piece shows as gone within about 1 second (epic section 13). Concurrency: two staff selling the linked piece at once, only one sale succeeds (EP-26-S3), and the line shows the winner's sale. Availability: "Reconnecting…" while the connection is down and catch-up on return (EP-08-S10). Open question: whether a line whose linked piece was sold stays routed or returns to unrouted.

## EP-30-S9: System can audit every link, unlink and route

- **Story ID:** EP-30-S9
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** System can audit every link, unlink and route
- **As a:** System
- **I want:** an append-only audit entry in the same transaction as each link (`line_linked_stock`), unlink (`line_unlinked`) and make route (`line_routed_make`), with actor, role, time, lead id, line id, piece or job id and the lead state before and after
- **So that:** the owner can see who decided how each item would be met, when, and which change converted or reopened a lead (FR-30-10)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given Rajesh Verma links TAG-8841 to the Sharma choker line, when it commits, then a `line_linked_stock` entry holds actor Rajesh, role Staff, time, LD-2026-208, the line id, after piece id TAG-8841, and lead state before `opened` and after `being_worked`.
  2. Given the haram line is sent to make, when the EP-19-S2 transaction commits, then a `line_routed_make` entry holds the line id, the new MO- job id and lead state after `converted`, beside the `order_copy_sent` entry.
  3. Given Rajesh unlinks the choker, when it commits, then a `line_unlinked` entry holds before piece id TAG-8841, after none, and lead state before `converted` and after `being_worked`.
  4. Given the operation rolls back, for example on "That line has already been routed.", when the log is read, then no line entry exists for it.
  5. Given Sanjay Seth filters the security log by kind group "Leads" and entity LD-2026-208, when the list loads, then these entries appear newest first; given a staff user reads the log, then it is refused (EP-06-S12).
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Entries are written through EP-06-S2 inside the operation's transaction and cannot be updated or deleted (EP-06-S1). Actor and time come from the session and the server clock (EP-03-S3). Entries hold the customer id through the lead, never the customer name or phone. The three new kinds join the "Leads" kind group from EP-28-S14.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None. Audit writes publish nothing.
- **Audit entry written:** Yes: actor, role, time, entity (lead id and line id), action (`line_linked_stock`, `line_unlinked`, `line_routed_make`), before, after (piece id or job id), lead state before and after.
- **Data changes:** Inserts into `audit_entries`. Adds the three kinds to the audit kind list in the shared package; migration widens the kind check constraint if it is a database enum.
- **UI reference:** The security log screen from EP-06-S9 to EP-06-S11. No new screen.
- **Non-functional checks:** Audit: every link, unlink and route is appended with actor and time (epic section 13). Personal data: entries store ids only, so an erasure (EP-17-S13) leaves no personal data in the log. Time: entry times in UTC, shown in Asia/Kolkata.
- **Depends on:** EP-30-S4, EP-30-S5, EP-30-S7, EP-28-S14, EP-19-S14, EP-06-S1, EP-06-S2, EP-06-S3, EP-06-S10, EP-06-S12
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

# EP-31: Staff Today home · stories

Epic document: [EP-31 Staff Today home](../epics/EP-31-staff-today-home.md)

Role note: stories where the server builds, ranks or computes on its own use "System". Staff land on `today`; the owner may open it to see the staff view but lands on `decisions` (EP-32); karigars never see it and every read here refuses them. This screen only reads, so no story here writes an audit entry or emits an event. v1 has no holds, so the mockup 02 card "Quotation QT-2026-0211 expires today" is out of scope and no story builds a quotation or hold card. No amount is read or shown. Weights are integers in units of 0.0001 g and shown to 4 decimals, so the mockup's "1,847.2 g" is shown as "1,847.2000 g" and "212.4 g" as "212.4000 g"; parcel gaps are shown in mg as on mockup 02 ("138 mg short"). The seed people are Sanjay Seth (Owner), Rajesh Verma and Deepak Rao (Staff), and the karigars Mahesh Soni, Lakshmi Devi · KG-01 and Vijay Kumar. The worked examples are BATCH-2026-044 from Mahesh Soni, stopped 138 mg short with 12 pieces held back, and BATCH-2026-043 from Lakshmi Devi with 9 pieces still untagged.

## EP-31-S1: System can build the "needs you now" cards for a staff member

- **Story ID:** EP-31-S1
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** System can build the "needs you now" cards for a staff member
- **As a:** System
- **I want:** one Read Today cards operation that, for the signed-in user, collects every waiting item from the pipeline tables (stopped parcels, open problems on jobs and pieces, open parcels, leads near or past the SLA) and returns them as cards, each with a stable key, a kind, a tone (`stop`, `wait` or `gold`), a title, a detail line and one action (label, route id and parameters)
- **So that:** Today is built from the server in one call instead of from the whole state in the browser, and only cards the user may act on are returned (FR-31-2, FR-31-8, BR-31-1, BR-31-3)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given BATCH-2026-044 is `stopped` with verdict `mismatch`, BATCH-2026-043 is `open` with 9 pieces untagged, and one lead has 1 hour left on its SLA, when Rajesh Verma calls Read Today cards, then one response holds exactly three cards with keys BATCH-2026-044, BATCH-2026-043 and the lead id.
  2. Given each card in the response, when it is inspected, then it has `key`, `kind` (one of `parcel_mismatch`, `parcel_problem`, `job_problem`, `piece_problem`, `parcel_unweighed`, `parcel_untagged`, `parcel_ready`, `lead_sla`, `more_leads`), `tone`, `title`, `detail` and an `action` with a `label` and a route id from `parcel-match`, `parcel-arrival`, `parcel-tag`, `lead-review`, `lead-convert`, `leads` or `stock`.
  3. Given the response for a staff caller, when any card is inspected, then no action points to an owner-only route such as `parcel-clear`, and the mismatch card's action opens the read view of `parcel-match` (BR-31-3).
  4. Given Sanjay Seth (Owner) calls Read Today cards, when it returns, then he gets the same card set a staff member would see; given Vijay Kumar (Karigar) calls it, then it is refused through EP-05-S2 and returns no card.
  5. Given the pipeline holds 40 parcels, 60 leads and 10 open problems on staging, when Read Today cards is called, then it answers in under 2 seconds on a shop connection.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Read Today cards is Staff and Owner only (EP-05-S2). Cards are built on the server from `parcels`, `problems`, `leads` and `pieces`; the browser does not compute which items are waiting. Card text uses the karigar and customer names from the server, gaps from the EP-23 verdict and the SLA phase from EP-28-S8. Each card kind is built by its own story (EP-31-S4, S5, S6); this story owns the response shape and the single call. No value or price field is returned.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None. This story is the read; live refresh is EP-31-S11.
- **Audit entry written:** No. Reads are not audited.
- **Data changes:** None in the product database. Adds Read Today cards and the card shape to the shared contract. Ports the card building in `src/components/home/StaffToday.tsx` and `gapPhrase`, `plural` from `src/components/home/util.ts` to the server.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/02-staff-home.svg` ("NEEDS YOU NOW · 3"), route `today`.
- **Non-functional checks:** Performance: one aggregated query, under 2 seconds (epic section 13). Security: only cards the caller may act on; no owner-only action offered to staff. D7 is decided: one shop, no branches; the read covers the shop.
- **Depends on:** EP-03-S1, EP-03-S2, EP-03-S3, EP-05-S2, EP-21-S1, EP-21-S10, EP-23-S2, EP-24-S1, EP-28-S1, EP-28-S8
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-31-S2: System can rank the cards by the decided rule

- **Story ID:** EP-31-S2
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** System can rank the cards by the decided rule
- **As a:** System
- **I want:** one server ranking function that orders the cards from EP-31-S1 by an ordered list of card kinds, then by a tie-break within each kind, with the kind order held in one place in the shared package
- **So that:** the most urgent work is first and the order is the same on every screen, once the owner decides between leads first and stops first (FR-31-7, BR-31-4, epic acceptance criterion 6)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given the decided kind order, when Read Today cards returns, then cards appear in that order of kinds, and the browser does not re-sort them.
  2. Given the rule is "stops first" (prototype order), when BATCH-2026-044 is stopped and a lead is past its SLA, then the order is `parcel_mismatch` or `parcel_problem`, then `job_problem` and `piece_problem`, then `parcel_unweighed`, `parcel_untagged` and `parcel_ready`, then `lead_sla` and `more_leads`.
  3. Given the rule is "leads first" (SCOPE-ANALYSIS §3), when the same items are waiting, then the `lead_sla` and `more_leads` cards come before every parcel and problem card.
  4. Given two cards of the same kind, when they are ranked, then lead cards are ordered most overdue first by elapsed time, and parcel and problem cards oldest first by stopped or arrival time, with the key as the last tie-break so the order is stable between calls.
  5. Given the ranking tests run in CI, when both candidate rules are exercised, then the chosen rule passes and the order for a fixed seed matches a stored expected list.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Ranking runs only on the server inside Read Today cards. The kind order is a constant in the shared package, not a setting, until the open question on the rule is answered. Ties never depend on database row order.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None. Ranking runs on each read; live refresh is EP-31-S11.
- **Audit entry written:** No. Ranking stores nothing.
- **Data changes:** None in the product database. Adds the ranking function and the kind order constant to the shared package.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/02-staff-home.svg` ("NEEDS YOU NOW · 3", card order), route `today`.
- **Non-functional checks:** Performance: ranking adds no extra query. Open question: the card ranking rule (leads first or stops first) must be decided before this story is done (epic acceptance criterion 6); the criteria above are written for either answer.
- **Depends on:** EP-31-S1
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-31-S3: Staff can land on Today after sign-in

- **Story ID:** EP-31-S3
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Staff can land on Today after sign-in
- **As a:** Staff
- **I want:** to arrive on `today` straight after signing in, with the greeting "Good morning, Rajesh" (or afternoon or evening) and the date in Asia/Kolkata, and with the screen loaded from the EP-08 data layer
- **So that:** my day starts on a short list of what matters, not on a 42-row table (FR-31-1, BR-31-1, BR-31-2)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given Rajesh Verma (Staff) signs in, when the session is created, then the app opens route `today` (EP-04-S6), and Sanjay Seth (Owner) still lands on `decisions` and a karigar on `k-jobs`.
  2. Given it is 08:35 on 1 November 2026 in Asia/Kolkata, when `today` loads, then the heading reads "Good morning, Rajesh" and the line under it reads "Sunday, 1 November 2026", using the first name from the session.
  3. Given the server clock is 23:30 UTC on 31 October (05:00 on 1 November in Asia/Kolkata), when `today` loads, then the date reads "Sunday, 1 November 2026" and the greeting is "Good morning".
  4. Given Read Today cards has not answered, when the screen is shown, then a loading state appears (EP-08-S3); given the read fails, then the error and "Try again" appear (EP-08-S4).

- **Audit entry written:** No. Sign-in is audited by EP-04-S14; opening a screen is not audited.
- **Data changes:** None in the product database. Moves `src/components/home/StaffToday.tsx` off `useStore()` onto the EP-08 data layer; `greetingFor` uses the Asia/Kolkata hour, not the browser's local hour.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/02-staff-home.svg` ("Good morning, Rajesh", "Sunday, 1 November 2026"), route `today`. The mockup's "Showroom staff · switch" is replaced by the account menu (EP-08-S14) and "counter opens in 25 minutes" is not built until shop hours exist (EP-13-S11).
- **Non-functional checks:** Performance: `today` loads under 2 seconds on a shop connection (BR-31-8). Time: greeting and date in Asia/Kolkata. Availability: loading, error, offline and reconnecting states (EP-08-S3, EP-08-S4, EP-08-S10, EP-08-S11). Security: the route is offered to Staff and Owner only.
- **Depends on:** EP-04-S6, EP-08-S3, EP-08-S4, EP-08-S10, EP-08-S11, EP-08-S12, EP-08-S13, EP-08-S17, EP-10-S10, EP-31-S1
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-31-S4: Staff can see stopped parcels, jobs and pieces as cards

- **Story ID:** EP-31-S4
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Staff can see stopped parcels, jobs and pieces as cards
- **As a:** Staff
- **I want:** a `stop` card for each parcel stopped by a mismatch or a raised problem, and for each job or piece with an open problem, each saying who or what stopped it and that only the owner can start it again
- **So that:** I know which pieces are held back and why, and I do not try to release what only the owner can (FR-31-3, FR-31-4, FR-31-8, BR-31-3)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given BATCH-2026-044 from Mahesh Soni is `stopped` with verdict `mismatch`, a net gap of −1380 units and 12 tagged pieces, when Rajesh Verma opens `today`, then a card reads "Parcel from Mahesh Soni is 138 mg short" with detail "BATCH-2026-044 · 12 pieces held back from the showcase. Only the owner can release this. Sent to him 20 minutes ago." and the action "Open parcel" opens `parcel-match` for BATCH-2026-044 (epic acceptance criterion 1).
  2. Given a parcel is stopped by a raised problem rather than a mismatch, when `today` loads, then the card reads "Parcel BATCH-2026-045 from Lakshmi Devi is stopped" with detail "Someone raised a problem on it. Only the owner can start it again." and "Open parcel".
  3. Given Vijay Kumar raised "Two kemp stones cracked while setting. I need a replacement before I can finish." on MO-2026-118, when `today` loads, then a card reads "Vijay Kumar stopped job MO-2026-118" with that text followed by "Only the owner can start it again."
  4. Given Deepak Rao raised a problem on TAG-9012, when `today` loads, then a card reads "Deepak Rao stopped piece TAG-9012" and the action "Open piece" opens `stock` with `pieceId` TAG-9012.
  5. Given the owner has resolved BATCH-2026-044 (sent back, re-check or loss accepted), when `today` is read, then no card for it is returned.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** A parcel card is built only for `status = stopped` with no resolution. A parcel stopped by a problem is shown once, as a parcel card, not again as a problem card. Gap and piece count come from the server verdict (EP-23-S2). The detail never offers a release action to staff; the release controls stay owner-only (EP-23-S6). The job card action opens the job tracker only if the caller may read it; a karigar's job card is never returned to a karigar.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None in this story; EP-31-S11 consumes "Parcel stopped (mismatch or raised problem)" and "Problem raised on a job or piece" / "Problem cleared" (proposed, G26) to refresh these cards.
- **Audit entry written:** No. Reads are not audited.
- **Data changes:** None in the product database. Builds the `parcel_mismatch`, `parcel_problem`, `job_problem` and `piece_problem` cards inside Read Today cards.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/02-staff-home.svg` ("Parcel from Mahesh Soni is 138 mg short", "BATCH-2026-044 · 12 pieces held back from the showcase", "Only the owner can release this. Request sent 09:12.", "Open parcel"), route `today`. Job and piece problem cards are not drawn; they reuse the same card.
- **Non-functional checks:** Precision: the gap is an integer in units of 0.0001 g, shown in mg ("138 mg short"). Security: no owner-only action offered to staff. Time: "Sent to him … ago" from the server `stoppedAt` in UTC.
- **Depends on:** EP-31-S1, EP-23-S2, EP-23-S6, EP-23-S7, EP-24-S1, EP-24-S3, EP-24-S4, EP-24-S5, EP-22-S5
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed
