## EP-34-S1: System can store broadcasts, recipients and showcases

- **Story ID:** EP-34-S1
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** System can store broadcasts, recipients and showcases
- **As a:** System
- **I want:** the `broadcasts`, `broadcast_recipients` and `broadcast_pieces` tables from EP-02-S12 extended with status, template, schedule, counts and per-recipient tracking, a `broadcast_templates` table for "Festive preview", "New arrivals" and "Blank", and new `showcases` and `showcase_pieces` tables with a hashed public link token
- **So that:** drafts, sends, schedules, delivery tracking and shared showcases survive a reload and can be audited, instead of living in the in-memory `Broadcast` record (FR-34-10, FR-34-11, FR-34-13, FR-34-15, epic section 9)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given an empty database, when migrations run, then `broadcasts` has columns id, created by, audience group (one of the customer groups or `All`), audience filters (structured, empty by default), message text, template id, status (`draft`, `scheduled`, `sending`, `sent`, `failed`), scheduled for (nullable), sent at, recipient count, skipped count and version.
  2. Given migrations have run, when `broadcast_recipients` is read, then each row has broadcast id, customer id, provider message id, send status, delivered at, opened at, replied at and lead id (nullable), with a unique key on (broadcast id, customer id).
  3. Given migrations have run, when `broadcast_templates` is read, then it holds `festive` ("Festive preview"), `new` ("New arrivals") and `blank` ("Blank") with their text, provider template name and approval status, and the `new` text is "Namaste {name}, new pieces have just arrived at Jai Gulab Dev. Come and see them whenever you are free."
  4. Given migrations have run, when `showcases` is read, then it has id, created by, created at, audience group or one customer id, public link token hash, link expires at and revoked at, and `showcase_pieces` links a showcase to piece ids; no column holds the raw token.
  5. Given a row is written with broadcast status `paused`, a recipient whose customer id does not exist, or a showcase piece that does not exist, when it is written, then the database refuses it.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Enum checks on status and audience group. Foreign keys from recipients to `customers`, from broadcast and showcase pieces to `pieces`, and from recipients to `leads`. The server sets id, created by, created at, version, counts and sent at; no client value sets them. The public token is stored only as a hash. No price, amount or value column on any of these tables; pure gold is read from `pieces`, not copied.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None
- **Audit entry written:** No. Creating tables writes no entry; sends, schedules and links are audited by EP-34-S7, EP-34-S10, EP-34-S13 and EP-34-S14a.
- **Data changes:** Migration on `broadcasts` (EP-02-S12) adds created by, audience filters, template id, status, scheduled for, sent at, recipient count, skipped count, version. Migration on `broadcast_recipients` adds provider message id, send status, delivered at, opened at, replied at, lead id and the unique key. Migration creates `broadcast_templates` (seeded with the three prototype templates), `showcases` and `showcase_pieces`. Adds audit kinds `broadcast_sent`, `broadcast_scheduled`, `showcase_sent`, `showcase_link_created` and `showcase_link_revoked` to the `audit_entries` kind list. Each table has the shop ID (EP-02-S3, D7).
- **UI reference:** No screen.
- **Non-functional checks:** Personal data: message text and recipient rows are personal data, covered by the retention and erasure rules (EP-17-S13). Time: all times stored in UTC. Security: the public token is hashed at rest. Open decision G17: scheduled for, delivered at, opened at and replied at stay null until G17 is decided. Open decision G9: the link columns stay unused until G9 is decided.
- **Depends on:** EP-02-S1, EP-02-S12, EP-02-S14, EP-17-S1, EP-22-S1, EP-28-S1
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-34-S2: System can resolve an audience to opted-in customers with a skipped count

- **Story ID:** EP-34-S2
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** System can resolve an audience to opted-in customers with a skipped count
- **As a:** System
- **I want:** a Read Audience count operation, and one server function used by it and by every send, that turns a customer group or `All` (plus any agreed filters) into the list of active customers whose current consent is opted in, with the count of those skipped because they are not
- **So that:** only customers who agreed are counted and messaged, and the count on screen is the same rule the send uses (FR-34-1, FR-34-2, FR-34-7, BR-34-1, BR-34-8)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given 90 active VIP Bridal customers of whom 86 are opted in, when Read Audience count is called for `VIP Bridal`, then it returns 86 reachable and 4 skipped.
  2. Given audience `All`, when the count is read, then every active customer of every group is counted once, opted-in ones as reachable and the rest as skipped.
  3. Given a VIP Bridal customer with `status` `erased` (EP-17-S13), when the audience is resolved, then they are neither reachable nor skipped.
  4. Given Meera opted out at the counter a minute ago (EP-17-S7), when the count is read again, then reachable falls by 1 and skipped rises by 1.
  5. Given 5,000 customers on staging, when Read Audience count is called for `All`, then it answers in under 2 seconds.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Read Audience count is Staff and Owner only; karigars are refused (EP-05-S2). Consent is the customer's latest consent event (EP-17-S2), read on the server. Group values come from the customer record (EP-17-S1); a group outside the agreed list is refused as a validation error (EP-03-S5). Filters other than group are refused until G19 is decided. The same resolve function is called at send time (EP-34-S7), not reused from an earlier count.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None
- **Audit entry written:** No. Reads are not audited.
- **Data changes:** None in the product database. Adds an index on customer group and consent state if the query plan needs it. Adds Read Audience count to the shared contract (EP-03-S1), replacing `reachable` in `src/components/marketing/util.tsx` as the source of truth.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/27-broadcast.svg`, route `broadcast` ("86 customers · all opted in to WhatsApp", "Only customers who opted in are counted.").
- **Non-functional checks:** Performance: audience counts under 2 seconds (epic section 13). Personal data: the count read returns numbers only, never names or phones; recipient lists are not written to logs. Open decision G19: which groups and filters exist ("Collectors", "Festive collector", "Bought in last 6 months" versus VIP Bridal, High net worth, Regular, Wholesale); this story supports the four stored groups and `All` until it is answered. Open decision G13: "Bought in last 6 months" needs a customer on each stock-out.
- **Depends on:** EP-17-S1, EP-17-S2, EP-17-S7, EP-17-S13, EP-05-S2, EP-03-S1, EP-03-S5, EP-34-S1
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

Open decision G19: the chips "Collectors", "Bought in last 6 months" and "+ add a filter" wait for the agreed groups and filters.

- **Story ID:** EP-34-S4

- **As a:** Staff

Note: the mockup's festive line "Shall we keep some aside for you to see?" promises a hold, which v1 does not have; the seeded festive text needs wording without it, agreed with the owner before approval.

- **Story ID:** EP-34-S5

- **As a:** Staff
- **I want:** "Attach pieces from the catalogue" to open a picker of in-stock pieces with photo, name, tag, purity and pure gold, and to save my choice on the broadcast draft, with the server refusing any piece not in stock
- **So that:** customers see the actual pieces, and nothing sold or scrapped ever goes out (FR-34-4, BR-34-3, BR-34-4, BR-34-10)

  1. Given TAG-8841 Kundan Choker, TAG-8802 Polki Bangles and TAG-7521 Temple Haram are `in_stock`, when Rajesh Verma presses "pick pieces" and chooses them, then the draft stores the 3 piece ids and the screen reads "3 attached".

Performance: the picker list loads under 2 seconds and is paged with a cursor (EP-03-S9). Security: photos are served through signed, expiring links (EP-09-S5).
- **Depends on:** EP-34-S1, EP-22-S1, EP-22-S2, EP-22-S3, EP-09-S5, EP-09-S7, EP-02-S14, EP-03-S9, EP-05-S2

## EP-34-S7: Staff can send a broadcast to opted-in customers

- **Story ID:** EP-34-S7
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Staff can send a broadcast to opted-in customers
- **As a:** Staff
- **I want:** to press "Send" on a draft so the server checks the message and pieces, resolves the audience to opted-in customers at that moment, writes one recipient row each, and hands one approved template message per recipient to the WhatsApp integration through a job queue
- **So that:** the whole group gets the message with their own name, and nobody who has not agreed gets anything (FR-34-7, FR-34-8, FR-34-9, FR-34-18, BR-34-1, BR-34-3, BR-34-7, epic acceptance criterion 1)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given 86 opted-in VIP Bridal customers and 3 `in_stock` pieces attached, when Rajesh Verma presses "Send" on the festive message, then 86 `broadcast_recipients` rows are written, 86 messages go out each with the first name filled in, and customers not opted in get nothing (epic acceptance criterion 1).
  2. Given the message box is empty, when "Send" is pressed, then the server refuses with "Write the message." and nothing is sent.
  3. Given everyone in the chosen audience has opted out, when "Send" is pressed, then the server refuses with "Nobody opted-in is in that audience."
  4. Given the network drops after Rajesh presses "Send" and he retries with the same idempotency key, when the retry reaches the server, then no second broadcast is created and no customer gets two messages (EP-08-S6, EP-03-S8).
  5. Given the send commits, when it is read, then status is `sending` until all recipient messages are handed over and then `sent`, recipient count is 86, skipped count is the not-opted-in number, and the screen reads "Going to 86 opted-in VIP Bridal customers" before and the latest broadcast after.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Create Broadcast is Staff and Owner only (EP-05-S2), unless the open question on who may send restricts it to the owner. Message must not be blank. Every attached piece must be `in_stock` at send time (EP-34-S8 explains refusals). The audience is resolved inside the send transaction (EP-34-S2); EP-12-S5 checks consent again per message. Each message goes through EP-12-S3 with an approved template and idempotency key "broadcast" plus broadcast id and customer id. Large audiences are sent through EP-10 jobs so provider rate limits are respected. The audit entry is written in the same transaction (EP-06-S2).
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None emitted. Broadcasts are not in the PRODUCTION-SCOPE §1 catalogue (epic section 11). The sender's own screen refetches after the send (EP-08-S7).
- **Audit entry written:** Yes: actor, time, entity (broadcast id), action `broadcast_sent`, audience group, recipient count, skipped count, piece ids, template id. No phone numbers or message bodies per recipient.
- **Data changes:** Updates the `broadcasts` row to `sending` then `sent` with sent at and counts; inserts `broadcast_recipients` rows; EP-12-S3 inserts OutboundMessage rows with the broadcast id as source; EP-10 job rows for the send batches. Adds Create Broadcast to the shared contract, replacing `sendBroadcast` in `src/store/transitions.ts`.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/27-broadcast.svg`, route `broadcast` ("Going to 86 opted-in VIP Bridal customers", "Send", "Later").
- **Non-functional checks:** Personal data: consent checked at the moment of sending; recipient lists are not exported in logs (epic section 13). Concurrency: a piece sold between attach and send is refused, not sent. Audit: every send appended. Availability: a provider failure on some recipients marks those rows failed (EP-12-S12) without stopping the rest. Open decision D8: provider and approved templates. Open question: whether any staff member or only the owner may send.
- **Depends on:** EP-34-S2, EP-34-S4, EP-34-S5, EP-12-S3, EP-12-S5, EP-12-S12, EP-10-S1, EP-10-S3, EP-10-S4, EP-03-S4, EP-03-S6, EP-03-S8, EP-05-S2, EP-06-S2, EP-08-S5, EP-08-S6, EP-08-S7
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

- **Story ID:** EP-34-S8

- **Title:** System can drop sold pieces from drafts live
- **As a:** System
- **I want:** when a piece is billed or scrapped, to remove it from every unsent broadcast draft, scheduled broadcast and showcase draft, and to tell any open `broadcast` or `catalogue` screen which piece went; and at send time, to refuse any attached piece that is no longer in stock and name it
- **So that:** a sold piece never goes out to customers, and the person writing the broadcast knows why it vanished (FR-34-5, BR-34-3, BR-34-9, epic acceptance criterion 2)

Given Rajesh Verma's draft has TAG-8841 attached and Deepak Rao sells TAG-8841 (EP-26-S2), when "Piece billed by one staff member" arrives, then within about 1 second TAG-8841 leaves the draft, the count reads "2 attached" and a line reads "TAG-8841 was sold just now and was taken off this broadcast." (proposed wording).

- **Non-functional checks:** Concurrency: a piece sold between attach and send is refused at send (epic section 13). Performance: the removal shows within about 1 second of the sale commit. Availability: reconnect catch-up applies the missed removal (EP-07-S7).
- **Depends on:** EP-34-S5, EP-34-S7, EP-26-S2, EP-26-S11, EP-07-S1, EP-07-S5, EP-07-S7, EP-07-S11, EP-08-S8, EP-08-S9, EP-08-S10

- **So that:** I can prepare the Deepavali eve message in advance and it goes out on time without me (FR-34-10, epic acceptance criterion 6)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given a draft to VIP Bridal, when Rajesh Verma presses "Later" and picks 31 October 2026 18:00 Asia/Kolkata, then the broadcast is stored with status `scheduled` and scheduled for 2026-10-31 12:30 UTC, and the screen shows the time in Asia/Kolkata.
  2. Given the scheduled time arrives, when the job runs, then the broadcast is sent through the EP-34-S7 path to the audience as resolved at that moment, so a customer who opted out in between gets nothing (epic acceptance criterion 6).
  3. Given Rajesh picks a time in the past, when he saves, then the server refuses with "Pick a time in the future." (proposed wording).
  4. Given the broadcast is `scheduled`, when Rajesh cancels it, then the job is cancelled and status returns to `draft`; given it is already `sending`, cancel is refused.
  5. Given the server is down at 18:00 and restarts at 18:20, when missed jobs run (EP-10-S11), then the broadcast is sent once, not twice.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Create Scheduled broadcast is Staff and Owner only (EP-05-S2). The time is stored in UTC and must be later than the server clock. The send at run time repeats every EP-34-S7 check (message, `in_stock` pieces, consent) with the System actor "Scheduler" and keeps the creator as created by. The job key is "broadcast" plus broadcast id (EP-10-S4). Only `scheduled` broadcasts can be cancelled.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None. The job is started by the scheduler.
- **Audit entry written:** Yes: on scheduling, actor, time, entity (broadcast id), action `broadcast_scheduled`, scheduled for, audience group, piece ids; on cancel, the same kind with before `scheduled` and after `draft`; at send, `broadcast_sent` with actor System "Scheduler" (EP-06-S6).
- **Data changes:** Sets `broadcasts.scheduled for` and status; inserts an EP-10 delayed job row; at run time the EP-34-S7 writes. Adds Create Scheduled broadcast and Cancel Scheduled broadcast to the shared contract.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/27-broadcast.svg`, route `broadcast` ("Send now, or schedule for Deepavali eve", "Later"). The date and time picker and the scheduled list are not yet designed.
- **Non-functional checks:** Time: schedules stored in UTC and chosen in Asia/Kolkata (EP-10-S10). Availability: a missed run sends once after restart. Concurrency: cancel and the job start cannot both win; the status check is in one transaction. Audit: every schedule appended. Open decision G17: whether scheduling is in scope for v1; this story is built only if G17 says yes, and "Later" stays hidden until then.
- **Depends on:** EP-34-S7, EP-10-S1, EP-10-S3, EP-10-S4, EP-10-S10, EP-10-S11, EP-10-S12, EP-06-S2, EP-06-S6, EP-05-S2
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-34-S11: Staff can see delivered, opened and replied counts (G17)

- **Story ID:** EP-34-S11
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Staff can see delivered, opened and replied counts (G17)
- **As a:** Staff
- **I want:** each sent broadcast to show how many messages were delivered, opened and replied to, from per-recipient times copied from WhatsApp receipts and reply leads, and to open the list of recipients who replied
- **So that:** I can see whether a broadcast reached people and follow up with those who answered (FR-34-11)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given a broadcast to 86 recipients, when the provider reports 84 delivered and 61 read through EP-12-S9, then Read Broadcast status returns 84 delivered and 61 opened, and the broadcast shows "84 delivered · 61 opened" (proposed wording).
  2. Given 16 recipients replied (EP-34-S9), when the status is read, then it shows "16 replied" and the reply list names each customer with a link to their lead.
  3. Given a recipient's message failed with "recipient not on WhatsApp", when the status is read, then it counts under failed with that reason, not under delivered.
  4. Given a read receipt arrives before the delivered receipt, when both are stored, then delivered at is set too, and the counts never go backwards.
  5. Given Rajesh Verma has the broadcast open, when he presses refresh or returns to it, then the counts reflect receipts stored so far.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Read Broadcast status is Staff and Owner only (EP-05-S2). Recipient delivered at and opened at are copied from OutboundMessage receipts (EP-12-S9) and only move forward. Opened means the provider's read receipt. Totals are computed on the server.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None. Receipts come through EP-12 provider callbacks, not a catalogue event; the screen shows stored counts on load and refresh (EP-08-S7).
- **Audit entry written:** No. Receipts are provider status, stored on the recipient and OutboundMessage rows; the send itself is audited by EP-34-S7.
- **Data changes:** Updates `broadcast_recipients` send status, delivered at and opened at from OutboundMessage receipts. Adds Read Broadcast status to the shared contract.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/27-broadcast.svg`, route `broadcast` ("AFTER YOU SEND", "Delivered, opened, and who replied are tracked — replies become leads."). The counts and reply list are not yet designed.
- **Non-functional checks:** Time: receipt times stored in UTC and shown in Asia/Kolkata. Personal data: the reply list shows names to Staff and Owner only and is not written to logs. Performance: status reads under 2 seconds for a broadcast of 5,000 recipients. Open decision G17: whether per-recipient tracking is in scope; until decided only the reply count from EP-34-S9 is shown. Open decision D8: whether the chosen provider returns read receipts.
- **Depends on:** EP-34-S7, EP-34-S9, EP-12-S9, EP-12-S12, EP-05-S2, EP-08-S7
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-34-S12: Staff can build a catalogue showcase with no price shown

- **Story ID:** EP-34-S12
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Staff can build a catalogue showcase with no price shown
- **As a:** Staff
- **I want:** on `catalogue`, to filter in-stock pieces by style, collection, weight and tag, choose some, see "A showcase of N pieces" with their total pure gold and "no price shown", and see each piece card as the customer will, with an empty value socket
- **So that:** I can put together a small product file of real stock that shows photos and weights but never a price (FR-34-13, BR-34-3, BR-34-4, BR-34-5, BR-34-10, epic acceptance criterion 4)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given 4 chosen `in_stock` pieces whose pure gold sums to 1727800 units, when Rajesh Verma views "HOW TO SEND IT", then it reads "A showcase of 4 pieces" and "172.7800 g of pure gold across them · no price shown", and no price appears anywhere (epic acceptance criterion 4).
  2. Given Rajesh types "Kundan" in "filter by style, collection, weight…", when List Shareable pieces returns, then only `in_stock` pieces with Kundan style or collection are listed, and the heading reads "PICK FROM WHAT IS IN STOCK · 4 CHOSEN" with his count.
  3. Given TAG-8841 is chosen, when "WHAT A PIECE LOOKS LIKE TO THEM" is shown, then it reads "Antique Kundan Choker", "22K · Kundan · Festive Bridal" and "Pure gold 41.5900 g", with the empty slot "price added here once pricing is on".
  4. Given `pricingEnabled` is true (EP-13-S9), when the card is shown, then the value socket still stays empty until EP-42 fills it.
  5. Given a weight filter of 20 to 50 g, when the list returns, then only pieces whose pure gold is between 200000 and 500000 units are shown.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** List Shareable pieces and Create Showcase draft are Staff and Owner only (EP-05-S2). Only `in_stock` pieces are listed or saved (EP-22-S2). The total is an integer sum on the server. The response carries no price, value or rupee field (BR-34-4). Choosing a piece does not hold it.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** Consumed through EP-34-S8: "Piece billed by one staff member" drops a sold piece from the picker and total. Emitted: none.
- **Audit entry written:** No. Building a draft showcase changes no business record; sending it and creating a link are audited by EP-34-S13 and EP-34-S14a.
- **Data changes:** Inserts a `showcases` row and `showcase_pieces` rows for the draft. Adds Create Showcase draft and filters on List Shareable pieces to the shared contract. Moves `src/components/marketing/CatalogueShare.tsx` off `useStore()` onto the EP-08 data layer.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/28-catalogue-share.svg`, route `catalogue` ("Share a set of pieces", "PICK FROM WHAT IS IN STOCK · 4 CHOSEN", "filter by style, collection, weight…", "A showcase of 4 pieces", "172.780 g of pure gold across them · no price shown", "WHAT A PIECE LOOKS LIKE TO THEM", "price added here once pricing is on"). The mockup shows 3 decimals; the product shows 4.
- **Non-functional checks:** Precision: total pure gold is an integer sum in units of 0.0001 g, shown to 4 decimals (epic section 13). Performance: the list loads under 2 seconds and is paged (EP-03-S9). Availability: loading, error, offline and reconnecting states (EP-08-S3, EP-08-S4, EP-08-S10, EP-08-S11). Security: photos through signed links (EP-09-S5).
- **Depends on:** EP-34-S1, EP-34-S5, EP-34-S8, EP-22-S1, EP-22-S2, EP-13-S9, EP-09-S5, EP-03-S9, EP-05-S2, EP-08-S3, EP-08-S4, EP-08-S10, EP-08-S11, EP-08-S17
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-34-S13: Staff can send a showcase to one person

- **Story ID:** EP-34-S13
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Staff can send a showcase to one person
- **As a:** Staff
- **I want:** to send a showcase either "To one person", by picking one opted-in customer, or "Send to a broadcast audience" through the same audience picker, so the server sends the chosen in-stock pieces with photos and pure gold through WhatsApp; and to reach "To one person" from the piece drawer's "Share" on `stock`
- **So that:** I can send a customer exactly the pieces they asked about, with the same consent and stock checks as a broadcast (FR-34-14, BR-34-1, BR-34-3, BR-34-4, FR-34-18)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given a showcase of 4 `in_stock` pieces and Priya Malhotra (CU-002) is opted in, when Rajesh Verma presses "To one person", picks Priya and sends, then one message goes to her with the 4 pieces' photos, names and pure gold, no price, and the showcase records her customer id.
  2. Given Rajesh picks a customer who is not opted in, when he sends, then the server refuses with "<name> is not opted in to WhatsApp, so nothing was sent." (proposed wording) and nothing is sent.
  3. Given Rajesh presses "Send to a broadcast audience" and picks "VIP Bridal · 86", when he sends, then the showcase goes out through the EP-34-S7 path to the 86 opted-in customers.
  4. Given one of the 4 pieces was sold before sending, when the server checks, then it refuses with "<tag> is not in stock, so it cannot be shown." and sends nothing.
  5. Given Rajesh opens TAG-8841 on `stock` and presses "Share", when the share opens, then it starts a one-piece showcase with "To one person" selected.

One-person sends check the customer's current consent (EP-17-S2) and again at EP-12-S5. If the customer has an open conversation window, EP-12-S4 may send a session message; otherwise an approved template is used (EP-12-S3). Idempotency key "showcase" plus showcase id and customer id. The audit entry is written in the same transaction.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None emitted. Consumed through EP-34-S8: "Piece billed by one staff member".
- **Audit entry written:** Yes: actor, time, entity (showcase id), action `showcase_sent`, audience group or one customer id, recipient count, piece ids. No phone numbers.
- **Data changes:** Updates the `showcases` row with the audience or customer id and sent at; for an audience send, creates a `broadcasts` row with the showcase pieces and `broadcast_recipients` rows; EP-12 inserts OutboundMessage rows. Adds Create Showcase send to the shared contract, replacing the fixed-message `sendBroadcast` call in `CatalogueShare.tsx`.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/28-catalogue-share.svg`, route `catalogue` ("HOW TO SEND IT", "Send to a broadcast audience", "reuses the audience picker from Broadcast", "To one person"); `docs/ux/mockups/03-showroom-stock.svg`, route `stock` ("Share"). The customer picker for "To one person" is not yet designed.
- **Non-functional checks:** Personal data: consent checked at send time; only opted-in customers are offered in the picker. Concurrency: a piece sold between choose and send is refused. Audit: every send appended. Open decision D8: whether a showcase with several photos fits an approved template or needs a session message.
- **Depends on:** EP-34-S7, EP-34-S12, EP-17-S2, EP-17-S8, EP-12-S3, EP-12-S4, EP-12-S5, EP-22-S5, EP-03-S8, EP-05-S2, EP-06-S2, EP-08-S5

## EP-34-S14a: Staff can create and revoke a public showcase link (G9) (part 1: create and revoke)

Split note: EP-34-S14 was split into S14a and S14b because creating and revoking the link is a signed-in staff action, while serving the page to anyone with the link is a new public surface with its own security, caching and performance checks.

- **Story ID:** EP-34-S14a
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Staff can create and revoke a public showcase link (G9)
- **As a:** Staff
- **I want:** "Copy a link" to create an unguessable link for the current showcase with an expiry, copy it to the clipboard, and let me revoke it later from the showcase
- **So that:** I can share a showcase with someone outside WhatsApp, and stop it working when it should no longer be seen (FR-34-15, FR-34-18)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given a showcase of 4 `in_stock` pieces, when Rajesh Verma presses "Copy a link", then the server creates a token of at least 128 random bits, stores only its hash with link expires at, returns the full link once, and the screen says "Link copied" (proposed wording).
  2. Given the link was created, when the database is read, then no column holds the raw token and the audit entry holds only a token reference (EP-06-S4).
  3. Given the link, when Rajesh presses "Revoke link", then revoked at is set and the link stops working at once (EP-34-S14b).
  4. Given the showcase has no `in_stock` pieces left, when "Copy a link" is pressed, then the server refuses with "None of these pieces are in stock now." (proposed wording).
  5. Given Deepak Rao calls Create Public showcase link many times a minute, when the rate limit in EP-03-S11 is reached, then further calls are refused.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Create and Delete Public showcase link are Staff and Owner only (EP-05-S2). The token is generated on the server from a secure random source and never logged (EP-12-S11 rule applied here). Expiry is set by the server from the G9 decision, never from the client. Revoke is allowed on any active link by Staff or Owner. The prototype's made-up link `https://jaigulabdev.example/showcase/{ids}` is removed.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None
- **Audit entry written:** Yes: on create, actor, time, entity (showcase id), action `showcase_link_created`, piece ids, link expires at, token reference; on revoke, action `showcase_link_revoked`, before (active) and after (revoked at).
- **Data changes:** Sets `showcases.public link token hash`, link expires at and revoked at. Adds Create Public showcase link and Delete Public showcase link to the shared contract.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/28-catalogue-share.svg`, route `catalogue` ("Copy a link"). "Revoke link" and the expiry display are not yet designed.
- **Non-functional checks:** Security: unguessable token, hashed at rest, expiry and revoke, reviewed in the EP-39 security review before release (epic section 13). Audit: every link creation appended. Open decision G9: whether a public link exists at all, how long it lasts and what it may show; this story ships only if G9 says yes, and "Copy a link" stays hidden until then.
- **Depends on:** EP-34-S12, EP-06-S2, EP-06-S4, EP-03-S11, EP-05-S2, EP-12-S11
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-34-S14b: Staff can create and revoke a public showcase link (G9) (part 2: public showcase page)

Split note: EP-34-S14 was split into S14a and S14b because creating and revoking the link is a signed-in staff action, while serving the page to anyone with the link is a new public surface with its own security, caching and performance checks.

- **Story ID:** EP-34-S14b
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Staff can create and revoke a public showcase link (G9)
- **As a:** System
- **I want:** a Read Public showcase operation and page that anyone with a valid link can open without signing in, showing only the chosen pieces that are still `in_stock`, with photo, name, purity, style and pure gold, and no price, tag history or customer data
- **So that:** a customer can browse the pieces on their phone, and a sold or scrapped piece never shows (FR-34-15, FR-34-16, BR-34-3, BR-34-4, epic acceptance criterion 5)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given a valid link to 4 pieces, when a customer opens it on a phone without signing in, then the page shows the 4 pieces with photo, name, purity and style, and pure gold such as "41.5900 g", and no price.
  2. Given TAG-8841 on the link is sold, when the link is opened again, then TAG-8841 no longer shows and the others still do (epic acceptance criterion 5).
  3. Given the link is past link expires at or has revoked at set, when it is opened, then the page says "This showcase is no longer available." (proposed wording) and shows no pieces.
  4. Given a made-up or altered token, when it is opened, then the same "no longer available" page is shown, with no hint whether the token ever existed.
  5. Given a mobile connection on staging, when the page is opened, then it loads in under 2 seconds.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Read Public showcase needs no session; the token is hashed and looked up, and expired, revoked and unknown tokens get the same answer. Only pieces in state `in_stock` at read time are returned. The response carries no customer id, name, phone, staff name, price, value, supplier or karigar. Photos are served through short-lived signed links (EP-09-S5) scoped to these pieces. Requests are rate-limited per address (EP-03-S11). The page is read-only.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None pushed to the public page. "Piece billed by one staff member" is reflected because each open reads the current state.
- **Audit entry written:** No. Public reads are not audited; they are counted in the request log without the token value.
- **Data changes:** None in the product database. Adds Read Public showcase to the shared contract as the only operation reachable without a session.
- **UI reference:** Not yet designed. The piece card follows `docs/ux/mockups/28-catalogue-share.svg` ("WHAT A PIECE LOOKS LIKE TO THEM", "Antique Kundan Choker", "22K · Kundan · Festive Bridal", "Pure gold", "41.590 g") without the price slot label.
- **Non-functional checks:** Security: no customer data, unguessable token, uniform answer for invalid tokens, rate limit, and the EP-39 security review before release. Performance: under 2 seconds on a mobile connection (epic section 13). Precision: pure gold from integer units shown to 4 decimals. Personal data: no personal data on the page. Open decision G9: whether the link exists, its lifetime and what it may show; this story ships only if G9 says yes.
- **Depends on:** EP-34-S14a, EP-22-S1, EP-26-S2, EP-09-S5, EP-09-S6, EP-03-S2, EP-03-S11
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

- **So that:** gold tied up on the floor is shown to customers in two taps instead of sitting unnoticed (FR-34-17)

Epic document: [EP-35 Reports](../epics/EP-35-reports.md)

Role note: stories where the server computes figures or checks access on its own use "System". Stories on the report screens use "Owner", because "Read every section's report" is an owner permission (mockup 11, BR-35-1). Staff and karigars are refused every report operation unless a later decision grants staff a report. No report screen, route id or mockup exists yet; "Not yet designed" in a UI reference means the screen comes from the design approved in EP-35-S1, and the route id `reports` used below is proposed. Every figure is grams or counts, never money (BR-35-3), and reports create no business records. The seed owner is Sanjay Seth; seed karigars include Mahesh Soni (KG-02), Lakshmi Devi and Vijay Kumar, as in mockup 08.

## EP-35-S1: Owner can review and approve the UX design of the report hub and section layout

- **Story ID:** EP-35-S1
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Owner can review and approve the UX design of the report hub and section layout
- **As a:** Owner
- **I want:** a design for the report hub, one reusable section-report layout, the period picker and export (if decided), with no branch picker (one shop, D7), drawn as mockups in `docs/ux/mockups/` and shown to me for approval before any report is built
- **So that:** reports answer the questions I actually ask, in grams and counts, and nobody builds screens I did not want (FR-35-1, BR-35-6, BR-35-7)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given no report is designed (MOCKUP-COVERAGE §3 "Everything (never designed)"), when the design pass ends, then mockups exist for the hub with the five sections stock, karigars, leads, intake and outreach, and for one section layout reused by all five.
  2. Given the design is shown to Sanjay Seth, when he reads each section, then every figure on it is in grams (4 decimals), milligrams, a percentage or a count, and none shows a value, price or "₹" (BR-35-3, BR-35-5).
  3. Given the design, when it is reviewed, then it names the route id for the hub, where the owner reaches it from the owner rail next to `decisions` (the "Reports" item in mockup 13), the default period and the periods offered.
  4. Given the open questions in section 17 (periods, export, staff access, G4, G5), when the design is approved, then each one is either answered by the owner and written into the design notes or marked as still open with the stories it holds back.
  5. Given Sanjay Seth approves the design, when the approval is recorded, then EP-35-S4 to EP-35-S13 may start, and no report story starts before it.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** None in the product. This is a design and approval step; the gate is that no report operation is merged before the approval is recorded in the design notes.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None
- **Audit entry written:** No. A design approval is not a product action; it is recorded in the design notes with the owner's name and date.
- **Data changes:** None in the product database. Adds new mockups under `docs/ux/mockups/` and design notes for the hub, section layout, period picker and export.
- **UI reference:** Not yet designed. Entry points to keep consistent: `docs/ux/mockups/13-notifications-escalation.svg` (owner rail "Reports"), `docs/ux/mockups/08-owner-home.svg`, route `decisions` ("Money and stock", "Gold on the floor", "Gold with karigars", "Metal lost this month", "Pieces that went out in October"), `docs/ux/mockups/11-roles-and-permissions.svg` ("Read every section's report"), `docs/ux/mockups/10-navigation-map.mmd` (node "Reports, section by section").
- **Non-functional checks:** Precision: the design shows weights to 4 decimals and loss gaps optionally in mg. Security: the design shows reports in the owner rail only. D7 is decided: no branch picker is drawn. Open decision G24: whether this work is planned before the EP-41 launch or after it as M8.

- **Story ID:** EP-35-S2
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** System can compute period totals from integer weight units
- **As a:** System
- **I want:** one set of shared report functions on the server that take a period (start and end dates in Asia/Kolkata), scope every query to the caller's shop, convert the period to UTC bounds, and return sums of integer weights in units of 0.0001 g, counts, and percentages computed from integers, using the same functions the Decisions home and the pool page already use for the same figures
- **So that:** every report total is exact, matches the source rows, and never disagrees with `decisions` or `metal-pool` (FR-35-10, FR-35-11, BR-35-5, BR-35-8, BR-35-9)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given 42 `in_stock` pieces whose pure gold sums to 18,470,000 units, when the floor total is computed, then it returns 18,470,000 and 42, and the display function shows "1,847.0000 g" (epic acceptance criterion 2).
  2. Given settled jobs for KG-02 with gold issued 4,473,000 and 1,600,000 units and loss 63,000 and 23,000 units, when loss for the period is computed, then it returns 86,000 units (8.6000 g, 8,600 mg) and 142 basis points, shown as "1.42%", the same figure as EP-16-S10.
  3. Given the period "1 October 2026 to 31 October 2026" in Asia/Kolkata, when it is converted, then the query bounds are 30 September 2026 18:30 UTC to 31 October 2026 18:30 UTC, and a piece sold at 1 November 2026 00:10 IST is not counted.
  4. Given a period whose end is before its start, or longer than the agreed maximum, when a report function is called, then it is refused as a validation error (EP-03-S5).
  5. Given the same day, when "Gold on the floor" is read from `decisions` (EP-32-S9) and from the stock report, then both return the same integer.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** All sums run in the database or the server on integer columns; no float arithmetic before display. Percentages are integer basis points, rounded half up. Period bounds are computed with the EP-10-S10 day-boundary function (midnight Asia/Kolkata). Every query is scoped to the caller's shop; the client cannot change the scope (D7). Value sockets on pieces, customers and stock-outs are never read.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None
- **Audit entry written:** No. Computing figures changes nothing.
- **Data changes:** None in the product database. Adds indexes on the time columns the reports filter on (`pool_entries` time, `pieces` `inStockAt`, `soldAt` and scrapped time, `parcels` arrival time, `leads` `arrivedAt`, broadcast and wish sent at) if query plans need them. Adds the report period type and the shared report functions to the shared package, reusing the gram conversion from EP-02-S2 and the logic behind `pureGoldOnFloor`, `daysInStock`, `goldWithKarigar` and `jobOverdueDays` in `src/store/selectors.ts`.
- **UI reference:** No screen.
- **Non-functional checks:** Precision: integer sums in units of 0.0001 g, converted only for display, percentages from integer units (epic section 13). Time: periods chosen in Asia/Kolkata and queried in UTC; a day boundary is midnight Asia/Kolkata. Performance: each function for a one-month period returns in under 1 second on staging data, so a section report can load under 2 seconds. D7 is decided: one shop, no branches.
- **Depends on:** EP-02-S2, EP-10-S10, EP-03-S5, EP-16-S10, EP-18-S1, EP-22-S1, EP-22-S10, EP-32-S9
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-35-S3: System can refuse report requests from anyone but the owner

- **Story ID:** EP-35-S3
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** System can refuse report requests from anyone but the owner
- **As a:** System
- **I want:** every report operation (List Report sections, Read Stock, Karigar, Leads, Intake and Outreach report, Create Report export) to check on the server that the caller holds the owner permission "Read every section's report", and to refuse everyone else
- **So that:** report figures, including other karigars' loss and lateness, reach only the owner, whatever the browser hides or shows (FR-35-12, BR-35-1, BR-35-2, epic acceptance criterion 3)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given Rajesh Verma is signed in as Staff, when he calls Read Stock report, then the server refuses it with a permission error (EP-05-S2) and returns no figures (epic acceptance criterion 3).
  2. Given Mahesh Soni is signed in as Karigar, when he calls Read Karigar report, then the server refuses it and returns no data about himself or any other karigar (BR-35-2).
  3. Given Sanjay Seth is signed in as Owner, when he calls any of the seven report operations, then the permission check passes.
  4. Given a request with no session or an ended session, when it reaches any report operation, then it is refused as unauthenticated and the client returns to sign-in (EP-08-S15).
  5. Given a staff user types the proposed hub route `reports` into the address bar, when the screen loads, then the route is not offered to the Staff role (EP-08-S13) and any data call it makes is refused by the server.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Permission "Read every section's report" is added to the Owner role only in the fixed permission list (EP-05-S1) and checked on every report operation (EP-05-S2). If a later decision grants staff a report, that grant is a separate permission per section, not a change to this check.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None
- **Audit entry written:** No. A refused read writes no audit entry unless EP-06 decides reads are audited; refusals are logged as security events by the API layer.
- **Data changes:** None in the product database. Adds the "Read every section's report" permission to the shared permission list.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/11-roles-and-permissions.svg` ("Read every section's report" under the owner; "Any other karigar's work or scorecard" under what a karigar never sees).
- **Non-functional checks:** Security: the role is checked on the server for every operation; a hidden rail item is not a control (epic section 13). Open question: whether any staff member sees any report; until answered, all seven operations are owner-only.
- **Depends on:** EP-05-S1, EP-05-S2, EP-03-S3, EP-08-S13, EP-08-S15
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-35-S5: Owner can choose a period for a section report

- **Story ID:** EP-35-S5
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Owner can choose a period for a section report
- **As a:** Owner
- **I want:** a period picker on the hub and on every section report, with the periods and the default agreed in the design, so that every figure on the screen is recomputed for the period I pick and the period stays the same when I move between sections
- **So that:** I can compare this month with last month, or look at one festive week, without asking anyone for numbers (FR-35-3, BR-35-9)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given Sanjay Seth opens the stock report, when no period has been picked, then the default period from the design is shown in the picker and used for every figure.
  2. Given Sanjay picks "October 2026", when the report reloads, then the request carries 1 October 2026 to 31 October 2026 and the header reads the same dates in Asia/Kolkata.
  3. Given Sanjay picks a custom range with the end before the start, when he applies it, then the server refuses with "The period must end after it starts." (proposed wording) and the previous figures stay.
  4. Given October is picked on the stock report, when Sanjay goes back to the hub and opens the leads report, then the leads report also shows October.
  5. Given a period that includes today, when the report is read, then figures run up to the server time of the request, and the header says "up to <time>" (proposed wording).
- **Rules enforced on the server:** The period is validated on the server (EP-35-S2): start and end are dates in Asia/Kolkata, end on or after start, length within the agreed maximum. The server converts to UTC; the client never sends UTC bounds. Only the periods offered by the design are accepted if custom ranges are not decided.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None
- **Audit entry written:** No. Choosing a period is a read.
- **Data changes:** None in the product database. Adds the period parameter to every report read in the shared contract; keeps the chosen period in the route's query string.
- **UI reference:** Not yet designed (period picker from EP-35-S1, proposed route `reports`).
- **Non-functional checks:** Time: periods chosen in Asia/Kolkata, converted to UTC, day boundary at midnight Asia/Kolkata (epic section 13). Performance: a one-month period loads in under 2 seconds. Open question: which periods are offered (day, week, month, custom) and the default; the acceptance criteria use "October 2026" as an example only.
- **Depends on:** EP-35-S1, EP-35-S2, EP-35-S4, EP-10-S10, EP-03-S5, EP-08-S5
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-35-S6: Owner can read the stock report

- **Story ID:** EP-35-S6
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Owner can read the stock report
- **As a:** Owner
- **I want:** the stock section, through Read Stock report, to show pure gold on the floor and its piece count at the end of the period, pieces held back from the floor (`draft`, `with_owner`, `stopped`) with their pure gold, pieces and pure gold that went out in the period, and pieces scrapped with the gold returned to the pool
- **So that:** I know how much gold is ready to sell, how much is stuck, and how much moved (FR-35-4, FR-35-10, FR-35-11, epic acceptance criteria 2 and 5)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given 42 pieces were `in_stock` at the end of October with pure gold summing to 18,470,000 units, when Sanjay Seth opens the stock report for October, then it shows "1,847.0000 g" and "42 pieces", matching the sum of the stored integer weights (epic acceptance criterion 2).
  2. Given 12 pieces of BATCH-2026-044 were `with_owner` and 1 piece was `stopped` at the end of the period, when the report loads, then "Held back from the floor" shows 13 pieces split by state with each state's pure gold to 4 decimals.
  3. Given 184 pieces were billed in October (stock-out records, EP-26), when the report loads, then "Pieces that went out" shows 184 and their pure gold summed from integer units.
  4. Given 2 pieces were scrapped in October and their recovery entries in the pool ledger total 254,000 units, when the report loads, then "Scrapped" shows 2 pieces and "25.4000 g returned to the pool", equal to the `recovered` entries of EP-18-S6.
  5. Given pricing is switched on (EP-13-S9), when the stock report loads, then no value, rate or "₹" appears anywhere on it (epic acceptance criterion 5).
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Owner-only (EP-35-S3). "On the floor at the end of the period" is computed from `piece_state_transitions` (EP-22-S1), not from the current status, so a past period shows its own figure. Pure gold is read from each piece as an integer; gross and stone weights are not re-derived. Gold returned to the pool is read from `pool_entries` of kind `recovered`, not recomputed. No value socket is read.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None
- **Audit entry written:** No. Reads are not audited unless EP-06 decides otherwise.
- **Data changes:** None in the product database. Adds Read Stock report to the shared contract. May add an index on `piece_state_transitions` time if the end-of-period query needs it.
- **UI reference:** Not yet designed (section layout from EP-35-S1, proposed route `reports`). Figures follow `docs/ux/mockups/08-owner-home.svg`, route `decisions` ("Gold on the floor", "1,847 g", "42 pieces, ready to sell", "Pieces that went out in October", "184").
- **Non-functional checks:** Precision: integer sums shown to 4 decimals. Performance: a one-month report loads in under 2 seconds. Security: owner check on the server.
- **Depends on:** EP-35-S2, EP-35-S3, EP-35-S4, EP-35-S5, EP-22-S1, EP-22-S2, EP-22-S11, EP-26-S1, EP-27-S6, EP-18-S6, EP-13-S9
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-35-S7: Owner can read stock ageing by days in stock

- **Story ID:** EP-35-S7
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Owner can read stock ageing by days in stock
- **As a:** Owner
- **I want:** the stock section to show the pieces on the floor at the end of the period grouped by days in stock, with the piece count and pure gold of each group, and the oldest piece's age
- **So that:** I can see how much gold has not moved and decide what to push or remake (FR-35-5)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given 6 `in_stock` pieces have been in stock for more than 90 days with pure gold summing to 1,964,000 units, and the oldest went in 108 days ago, when Sanjay Seth reads the ageing part of the stock report, then the oldest group shows 6 pieces, "196.4000 g" and "oldest is 108 days".
  2. Given a piece went `in_stock` at 23:50 IST on 1 October and the period ends on 31 October, when days in stock are counted, then it counts 30 days, using midnight Asia/Kolkata as the day boundary.
  3. Given a piece was `stopped` and returned to `in_stock`, when its age is computed, then it is counted from its first `inStockAt`, the same as `daysInStock` on `decisions` (proposed, to confirm with EP-32).
  4. Given the group boundaries come from the ageing threshold setting (EP-13-S8), when the owner changes the threshold from 90 to 60 days, then the next read of the report groups by the new threshold.
  5. Given the ageing groups are summed, when they are added together, then their piece count and pure gold equal the floor figures of EP-35-S6 for the same period.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Owner-only (EP-35-S3). Days in stock are computed on the server from `inStockAt` and the period end with the EP-10-S10 day function, using the same shared function as the ageing alert on `decisions` (EP-32-S11). Group boundaries are read from shop settings on the server.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None
- **Audit entry written:** No. Reads are not audited.
- **Data changes:** None in the product database. Adds the ageing groups to Read Stock report in the shared contract.
- **UI reference:** Not yet designed (section layout from EP-35-S1, proposed route `reports`). Figures follow `docs/ux/mockups/08-owner-home.svg`, route `decisions` ("GOLD SITTING TOO LONG", "196.4 g of gold has not moved in 90 days", "oldest is 108 days").
- **Non-functional checks:** Precision: group totals are integer sums shown to 4 decimals. Time: days counted across midnight Asia/Kolkata. Open decision G5: the ageing threshold and so the group boundaries; until it is decided the report shows a single 90-day boundary as in mockup 08.
- **Depends on:** EP-35-S6, EP-13-S8, EP-32-S11, EP-10-S10, EP-22-S1
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

Wishes are read from `wishes` by sent at (EP-33-S1); broadcasts from `broadcasts` by sent at with their stored recipient and skipped counts (EP-34-S1); replies and leads from `broadcast_recipients`. Showcases are counted only if they are tracked separately (EP-34-S9).
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None
- **Audit entry written:** No. Reads are not audited.
- **Data changes:** None in the product database. Adds Read Outreach report to the shared contract.
- **UI reference:** Not yet designed (section layout from EP-35-S1, proposed route `reports`). Broadcast figures follow `docs/ux/mockups/27-broadcast.svg`, route `broadcast` ("AFTER YOU SEND").
- **Non-functional checks:** Personal data: counts only; no recipient list, phone or message text (epic section 13). Open decision G17: delivered, opened and replied tracking per recipient; delivered and opened appear only if G17 is decided.
- **Depends on:** EP-35-S2, EP-35-S3, EP-35-S4, EP-35-S5, EP-33-S1, EP-33-S4, EP-33-S12, EP-34-S1, EP-34-S7, EP-34-S9, EP-34-S11
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-35-S13: Owner can export a section report (if export is decided)

- **Story ID:** EP-35-S13
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Owner can export a section report (if export is decided)
- **As a:** Owner
- **I want:** an export action on each section report that, through Create Report export, produces a file of that section for the chosen period in the decided format, which I can download through a signed, expiring link
- **So that:** I can keep the figures or share them with my accountant without retyping (FR-35-14)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given Sanjay Seth is on the intake report for October, when he presses export, then a file is produced in the decided format with the same figures as the screen, weights to 4 decimals, and a header naming the shop, section, period and time of export in Asia/Kolkata.
  2. Given the file is ready, when Sanjay downloads it, then it is served through a signed link that expires (EP-09-S5), and a staff user opening the link after expiry or without the owner session is refused.
  3. Given an export is made, when it completes, then a ReportExport record and an audit entry are written with requested by, section, period and time.
  4. Given a staff user calls Create Report export, when it reaches the server, then it is refused (EP-35-S3).
  5. Given pricing is switched on, when an export is produced, then the file contains no value, rate or currency column.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Owner-only (EP-35-S3). The file is built on the server from the same functions as the screen (EP-35-S2), in a background job if it takes longer than the request allows (EP-10-S1). The file is stored through EP-09-S1 with the retention rule of EP-09-S12. The audit entry is written in the same transaction as the ReportExport record (EP-06-S2).
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None
- **Audit entry written:** Yes: actor (owner), time, entity (ReportExport id), action `report_exported`, section, period, file id.
- **Data changes:** Migration creates `report_exports` (id, requested by, section, period start, period end, shop ID, file id, created at) and adds the audit kind `report_exported` to the `audit_entries` kind list. Stores the export file in object storage (EP-09-S1). Adds Create Report export to the shared contract.
- **UI reference:** Not yet designed (export from EP-35-S1, proposed route `reports`).
- **Non-functional checks:** Personal data: an export that lists customer names is personal data under the DPDP Act 2023 and follows the retention and erasure rules (EP-17-S13, EP-09-S12); EP-39 rules apply when written. Security: signed, expiring download links. Audit: every export recorded. Open question: whether export is needed and in which format; this story is built only if export is decided.
- **Depends on:** EP-35-S2, EP-35-S3, EP-35-S6, EP-35-S8, EP-35-S9, EP-35-S10, EP-35-S11, EP-09-S1, EP-09-S5, EP-09-S6, EP-09-S12, EP-10-S1, EP-06-S2, EP-17-S13
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

# EP-36: Scale and printer hardware · stories

Epic document: [EP-36 Scale and printer hardware](../epics/EP-36-scale-and-printer-hardware.md)

Role note: stories where the server checks a reading or records its source, and where the counter computer talks to a device on its own, use "System". How the browser reaches a balance, printer or scanner (direct device access from the browser, or a small local program on the counter computer) is open under D9, so this file calls it "the device link" and stays neutral. Typing every weight and every tag by hand stays available on every screen. The seed scales are Bench balance (readability 0.0001 g, capacity 600 g) and Platform scale (readability 0.01 g, capacity 30,000 g). Seed staff are Rajesh Verma and Deepak Rao; the seed owner is Sanjay Seth. Labels and sheets carry no price (BR-36-8).

---

## EP-36-S1: System can store devices and link a balance to a registered scale

- **Story ID:** EP-36-S1
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** System can store devices and link a balance to a registered scale
- **As a:** System
- **I want:** a `devices` table holding each balance, label printer, sheet printer and scanner with its kind, model, counter, active flag and, for a balance, the one registered scale it is linked to, plus a List Devices operation
- **So that:** every reading can be traced to one physical device and one scale in the registry, and the ceiling never uses a scale other than the one that weighed (FR-36-3, FR-36-14, BR-36-2)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given the migration runs on an empty dev database, when it finishes, then `devices` exists with `id`, `kind` (`balance`, `label_printer`, `sheet_printer`, `scanner`), `model`, `counter_key`, shop ID, `scale_id` (nullable), `active`, `created_at` and `version`, and it can be rolled back.
  2. Given a device of kind `balance` with no `scale_id`, when it is inserted, then the database rejects it, because every balance must link to a registered scale.
  3. Given a device of kind `label_printer` with a `scale_id` set, when it is inserted, then the database rejects it, because only a balance links to a scale.
  4. Given two active balances at counter "Counter 1", one linked to Bench balance and one to Platform scale, when Rajesh Verma calls List Devices, then both are returned with the scale name, readability (1 unit, shown "0.0001 g") and capacity (6,000,000 units, shown "600.0000 g") of the linked scale.
  5. Given Mahesh Soni is signed in as Karigar, when he calls List Devices, then the server refuses it with a permission error (EP-05-S2).
- **Rules enforced on the server:** List Devices is Owner and Staff only; Karigar is refused. Check constraints: `kind` is one of the four values; `scale_id` is required for `balance` and null for every other kind; `scale_id` references `scales`. A balance may link only to an `active` scale at the time it is linked. `version` backs the EP-02-S14 stale-write check.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None
- **Audit entry written:** No. This story creates storage and a read; device changes are audited in EP-36-S3.
- **Data changes:** Migration creates `devices` (columns above) with a foreign key to `scales` and an index on `counter_key`. Adds List Devices to the shared contract (EP-03-S1). No money fields.
- **UI reference:** No screen.
- **Non-functional checks:** Precision: readability and capacity are read from `scales` as integers in units of 0.0001 g and shown to 4 decimals. Security: List Devices returns no device secrets or local addresses beyond what the counter needs. Open decision D9: the `model` values and any connection fields depend on which devices the shop uses. D7 is decided: one shop, no branches; devices carry the shop ID and no branch key.
- **Depends on:** EP-02-S1, EP-02-S2, EP-02-S4, EP-02-S14, EP-03-S1, EP-05-S2, EP-14-S1, EP-14-S8
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

---

## EP-36-S2: System can record whether each weight was read or typed

- **Story ID:** EP-36-S2
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** System can record whether each weight was read or typed
- **As a:** System
- **I want:** every weighing on a parcel and every gross and stone figure on a piece to store its source (`read` or `typed`) and the device id when it was read, set by the save operations of EP-21
- **So that:** when a parcel stops at the gate, the owner can see whether a figure came off the balance or was typed, and audits can tell a typing slip from a scale problem (FR-36-6, BR-36-1, epic section 13 Audit)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given Rajesh Verma saves the weighing "Whole parcel" for BATCH-2026-044 with gross 485.5000 g read from the Bench balance device and stones 38.2000 g typed, when it is read back, then `parcel_weighings` holds `4855000` with `gross_source` `read` and the device id, and `382000` with `stone_source` `typed`.
  2. Given TAG-9108 is saved with "On the scale now" 84.5000 g and "Stones, kemp, lac on this piece" 6.1000 g both read from the balance, when it is read back, then `pieces` holds `845000` and `61000`, both sources `read`, and `weight_device_id` set.
  3. Given a request that says `read` but names no device id, or names a device that is not an active balance, when it is saved, then the server refuses it as a validation error (EP-03-S2) and nothing is written.
  4. Given the migration runs on a staging copy loaded with the prototype seed, when it finishes, then every existing weighing and piece has source `typed` and a null device id.
  5. Given a saved weighing, when the EP-21-S14 audit entry for it is written, then it includes the source and device id of each figure.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Source is one of `read` or `typed` and is required for every gross and stone figure. `read` requires a device id of an active `balance`; `typed` requires the device id to be null. A `read` figure passes exactly the same weight checks as a typed one (gross greater than 0, stones from 0 to gross, EP-21-S5). The client cannot mark a figure `read` from a device that belongs to another counter than the caller's (proposed rule).
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None
- **Audit entry written:** Yes, through the existing EP-21-S14 entries: actor, time, entity (parcel or piece id), action (`parcel_arrival_recorded`, `parcel_weighing_added`, tag save kinds), after now includes each figure's source and device id.
- **Data changes:** Migration adds `gross_source`, `stone_source` (enum `read` or `typed`, default `typed` for back-fill) and `device_id` (nullable, foreign key to `devices`) to `parcel_weighings`; adds `gross_source`, `stone_source` and `weight_device_id` to `pieces`. Updates the Create and Update Parcel arrival and Create and Update Tag contracts with the source fields.
- **UI reference:** No screen.
- **Non-functional checks:** Audit: source and device are recorded for every weight, as epic section 13 requires. Precision: the stored weight is the same integer in units of 0.0001 g whatever its source. Open decision G10: if the unit becomes finer, these columns are unaffected but the weight columns beside them change.
- **Depends on:** EP-36-S1, EP-21-S1, EP-21-S2, EP-21-S3, EP-21-S5, EP-21-S6, EP-21-S14, EP-03-S2, EP-06-S5
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-36-S3: Owner can set up the balance and printer for a counter

- **Story ID:** EP-36-S3
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Owner can set up the balance and printer for a counter
- **As a:** Owner
- **I want:** a device setup panel on `scales` where I add a device, pick its kind and model, set its counter, link a balance to a registered scale, and switch a device off, through Create Device and Update Device
- **So that:** each counter knows which balance it reads and which printer it prints on, without staff choosing every time (FR-36-14, BR-36-2, epic section 13 Security)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given Sanjay Seth is on `scales`, when he adds a device of kind "Balance" at "Counter 1" linked to Bench balance, then it appears in the device list for Counter 1 with "Bench balance · 0.0001 g" beside it.
  2. Given Sanjay adds a label printer and a sheet printer at Counter 1, when Rajesh Verma signs in at Counter 1, then the tag and match screens use those printers without asking him to pick.
  3. Given Sanjay switches the Counter 1 balance off, when Rajesh opens `parcel-arrival`, then no "Read from balance" control is shown and he types the weight and picks the scale as today.
  4. Given Rajesh Verma is signed in as Staff, when he calls Create Device or Update Device, then the server refuses it with a permission error and nothing changes.
  5. Given Sanjay tries to link a balance to Platform scale after it was retired (EP-14-S7), when he saves, then the server refuses it with a sentence saying the scale is retired.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Create Device and Update Device are Owner only (EP-05-S2). The counter must be one of the counter values used for staff (EP-05-S4). A balance must link to an active scale. Version check on Update Device. The change and its audit entry share one transaction (EP-06-S2).
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None
- **Audit entry written:** Yes: actor, time, entity (device id), action (`device_added`, `device_edited`, `device_deactivated`, `device_reactivated`), before, after (kind, model, counter, linked scale id, active).
- **Data changes:** Inserts and updates `devices` (EP-36-S1). Adds Create Device and Update Device to the shared contract and the four device kinds to the audit kind list.
- **UI reference:** Not yet designed (device setup panel, epic section 12). It sits on route `scales`; the counter assignment control is EP-14-S8.
- **Non-functional checks:** Security: only the owner can register or change a device; staff and karigars are refused on the server. Audit: every device change writes an append-only entry. Open decision D9: the list of models offered and any connection setting (port, local program address) depend on the devices chosen. D7 is decided: no branch is picked with the counter.
- **Depends on:** EP-36-S1, EP-14-S3, EP-14-S7, EP-14-S8, EP-05-S2, EP-05-S4, EP-06-S2, EP-08-S5, EP-08-S17
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-36-S4: Staff can read a stable weight from the balance on parcel arrival

- **Story ID:** EP-36-S4
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Staff can read a stable weight from the balance on parcel arrival
- **As a:** Staff
- **I want:** a "Read from balance" control beside "Everything on the scale together" and "Of that, the stones, pearls, lac — anything not gold" on `parcel-arrival`, for the whole parcel and for each tray, that fills the field only once the balance reports a stable value
- **So that:** the parcel's three figures come straight off the balance and cannot carry a typing slip into the exact-match gate (FR-36-1, FR-36-4, FR-36-5, BR-36-1, BR-36-4)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given the Bench balance is connected at Counter 1 and BATCH-2026-044 is on it, when Rajesh Verma presses "Read from balance" and the balance reports stable 485.5000 g, then "Everything on the scale together" shows "485.5000" and "Which scale is this on?" shows "Bench balance · 0.0001 g".
  2. Given the balance is still settling, when Rajesh presses "Read from balance", then the field stays empty, the screen says the balance is settling, and it fills only when a stable value arrives (epic acceptance criterion 2).
  3. Given a parcel weighed in trays, when Rajesh reads "Tray 1" and then "Tray 2", then each tray takes its own fresh reading and "Tray 2" is never filled from the "Tray 1" value (BR-36-3).
  4. Given a reading of 612.0000 g on the Bench balance (capacity 600 g), when it fills the field, then the EP-14-S11 capacity warning is shown, as for a typed figure.
  5. Given Rajesh saves the arrival, when the server stores it, then each figure taken from the balance has source `read` and the Counter 1 balance device id, and the pure gold line reads "447.3000 g".
- **Rules enforced on the server:** All EP-21-S2 and EP-21-S3 checks apply unchanged to a read figure. The scale id of a read figure is set from the device link (EP-36-S6). A read figure is recorded with source `read` and the device id (EP-36-S2). The stable flag is checked on the counter by the device link; the server does not trust it as a weight check.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None
- **Audit entry written:** Yes, through EP-21-S14: actor, time, entity (parcel id), action (`parcel_arrival_recorded` or `parcel_weighing_added`), after (each weighing's scale id, gross and stones in integer units, source, device id).
- **Data changes:** None in the product database beyond EP-36-S2. Adds the device link reader and the "Read from balance" control to `ParcelArrival.tsx` and `ScaleAndWeights.tsx`, on the EP-08 data layer.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/20-parcel-arrival.svg`, route `parcel-arrival` ("WEIGH THE WHOLE PARCEL · ALL THREE FIGURES", "Which scale is this on?", "Bench balance · 0.0001 g", "Everything on the scale together", "485.5000", "38.2000", "SO THE PURE GOLD IN THIS PARCEL IS"). The "Read from balance" control and the settling state are not yet designed.
- **Non-functional checks:** Precision: the reading is converted to integer units of 0.0001 g from its text form without floating point; a value with more decimals than the scale's readability is not silently rounded (open question below). Performance: a stable reading appears in the field within 1 second of the balance settling. Open decision D9: which balances have a data output and how the browser reaches them. Open decision G10: whether the unit becomes finer.
- **Depends on:** EP-36-S1, EP-36-S2, EP-36-S3, EP-36-S6, EP-21-S2, EP-21-S3, EP-14-S11, EP-02-S2
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-36-S6: System can set the scale id from the device that gave the reading

- **Story ID:** EP-36-S6
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** System can set the scale id from the device that gave the reading
- **As a:** System
- **I want:** the server to take the scale id of any `read` figure from the linked scale of the named balance device, ignoring any scale id the client sends for it, and to refuse a reading whose scale is not in the registry
- **So that:** the ceiling is always computed from the scale that actually weighed, and staff never retype or change the scale for a read figure (FR-36-3, FR-36-7, BR-36-2, BR-36-5)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given the Counter 1 balance device is linked to Bench balance, when a weighing arrives marked `read` from that device with client scale id Platform scale, then the server stores Bench balance as the scale id.
  2. Given a figure is filled from the balance on `parcel-tag`, when Rajesh Verma looks at the scale picker, then it shows Bench balance and cannot be changed for that reading; clearing the reading and typing instead makes the picker editable again.
  3. Given a balance device whose linked scale was retired after linking, when a reading from it is saved, then the server refuses it with a sentence saying the scale is not in the registry (FR-36-7).
  4. Given a parcel with one weighing read on Bench balance and one typed on Platform scale, when Compute Ceiling runs (EP-14-S10), then it uses Bench balance for the first and Platform scale for the second.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** For a `read` figure the scale id comes from `devices.scale_id`, never from the request. The device must be an active `balance` and its scale `active`. A typed figure keeps the scale id the staff member picked, checked against the registry as today. The scale picked by the device updates the caller's last scale (EP-14-S9).
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None
- **Audit entry written:** No new entry. The scale id is part of the EP-21-S14 weighing and tag entries.
- **Data changes:** None in the product database. Changes the Create and Update Parcel arrival and Create and Update Tag service functions to derive the scale id for read figures.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/14-match-rule-any-parcel.svg` ("Every weighing remembers which scale it was on"); picker on routes `parcel-arrival` and `parcel-tag`.
- **Non-functional checks:** Security: a client cannot pick a coarser scale for a read figure to widen the ceiling. Precision: the ceiling stays an integer sum of half-steps; G10 decides the unit. Open decision D9: one device per scale is assumed.
- **Depends on:** EP-36-S1, EP-36-S2, EP-14-S9, EP-14-S10, EP-21-S5
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-36-S7: Staff can fall back to typing a weight when no device is connected

- **Story ID:** EP-36-S7
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Staff can fall back to typing a weight when no device is connected
- **As a:** Staff
- **I want:** to type any weight and pick the scale by hand on `parcel-arrival` and `parcel-tag` whenever the balance is missing, switched off or drops mid-form, without losing what I have entered
- **So that:** a broken cable or a balance with no data output never stops the shop (FR-36-8, epic section 13 Availability)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given no balance is set up at Counter 1, when Rajesh Verma tags a piece, then he types "On the scale now" and "Stones, kemp, lac on this piece" and picks "Which scale is this piece on?" by hand, as today (epic acceptance criterion 3).
  2. Given the balance disconnects after Rajesh read the gross 84.5000 g, when he reaches the stones field, then the screen says the balance is not connected, the gross stays filled, and he can type the stones.
  3. Given Rajesh has read a figure from the balance, when he clears it and types a different one, then the figure is saved with source `typed` and no device id.
  4. Given a typed figure, when it is saved, then it passes the same server checks and the same ceiling as a read figure.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** A `typed` figure needs a scale id picked by the staff member, which must be active in the registry. All EP-21-S2, EP-21-S3 and EP-21-S5 checks apply. Source `typed` with a null device id.
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None
- **Audit entry written:** Yes, through EP-21-S14: the figure's source `typed` is recorded with the weight and scale id.
- **Data changes:** None in the product database. Keeps `ScalePicker` and `parseWeight` as the fallback path on both screens.
- **UI reference:** `docs/ux/mockups/20-parcel-arrival.svg`, route `parcel-arrival` ("Which scale is this on?"); `docs/ux/mockups/21-tag-one-item.svg`, route `parcel-tag`. The "not connected" line is not yet designed.
- **Non-functional checks:** Availability: losing the device keeps the form and its typed values. Precision: typed text is converted with the EP-02-S2 helper to integer units of 0.0001 g.
- **Depends on:** EP-36-S4, EP-36-S5, EP-36-S2, EP-21-S2, EP-21-S6, EP-14-S9, EP-02-S2
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed

## EP-36-S8: Staff can print a tag label with a barcode

- **Story ID:** EP-36-S8
- **Status:** Not started
- **Title:** Staff can print a tag label with a barcode
- **As a:** Staff
- **I want:** to print a label for a saved piece on the counter's label printer, showing the tag number as a barcode and as text, with the other agreed fields and no price, through Read Tag label and Create Label print record
- **So that:** each piece carries a tag that a scanner can read at stock-out (FR-36-9, BR-36-6, BR-36-8)
- **Acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then):**
  1. Given TAG-9101 is saved, when Rajesh Verma chooses to print its label, then the label shows "TAG-9101" as a barcode and as text, and no price or "₹" appears (epic acceptance criterion 4).
  2. Given the label prints, when it is scanned on `stock-out`, then the scanner returns "TAG-9101" exactly.
  3. Given the print is sent, when it completes, then a `label_prints` row exists with the piece id, Rajesh as printer, the time, the label printer device id and reprint count 0.
  4. Given the piece has no saved tag yet, when Read Tag label is called, then the server refuses it with a not-found error.
  5. Given no label printer is set up at the counter, when Rajesh opens the tag, then the print control says no printer is set up and the tag save is unaffected.
- **Rules enforced on the server:** Read Tag label and Create Label print record are Staff and Owner only. The piece must exist and have a tag number. The label content is built on the server from the piece record; it never includes value fields. The device must be an active `label_printer`. Printed by and printed at come from the session and server clock (EP-03-S3).
- **Live events emitted / consumed:** None
- **Audit entry written:** No. The print is recorded in `label_prints`; it changes no piece or stock record.
- **Data changes:** Migration creates `label_prints` (id, piece id, printed by, printed at, device id, reprint count). Adds Read Tag label and Create Label print record to the shared contract.
- **UI reference:** Not yet designed (label layout, epic section 12). The print control sits on route `parcel-tag` (`docs/ux/mockups/21-tag-one-item.svg`).
- **Non-functional checks:** Performance: a label prints within 3 seconds of saving a tag. Security: label content is built on the server so no value field can leak onto it. Open decision D9: printer model. Open decision: label fields (tag number, HUID, purity, weights) and barcode format.
- **Depends on:** EP-36-S1, EP-36-S3, EP-21-S6, EP-15-S6, EP-15-S8, EP-03-S3, EP-05-S2
- **Definition of done:** code reviewed · tests pass · deployed to staging · acceptance criteria demoed
